Fellow Conservative,

I am pledging to put our country on the path to American renewal. Over the next 18 months, Americans will face a choice to reverse the decline of our country or surrender our American ideals to woke ideology. I refuse to stand down and watch the work of our Founding Fathers fade into a form that is unrecognizable. I know that freedom is worth fighting for, and a leader **always** finds a way. We're going to make sure truth is the foundation of everything we do in this country, Fellow Conservative, and we're going to make sure common sense is no longer an uncommon virtue. We are going to be strong, we are going to be energetic, and we're going to get things done. **_I am not going to lead merely with words. I am going to lead with deeds and I'm going to produce results._** As we near the end of the FEC fundraising quarter--**June 30th** --I want to make it clear to the Left that we are waging a war on woke ideology and we are WINNING. This first end-of-quarter deadline means we have reached the point where our campaign fundraising is showcased and compared across the field. **Fellow Conservative, this is our opportunity to prove our strength. This is our opportunity to show Joe Biden how strong our movement is. This is our opportunity to produce historic results.** _I have the humility to know that I cannot do this alone. I am asking for your help to win this race for all of us. _ There is no substitute for victory, Fellow Conservative. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| I promise to keep up the fight for LGBTQ rights until every person can live freely, openly, and authentically.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=462%2E35263%2Ehwr5Iq)
Peter — 8 years ago today, the Supreme Court made marriage equality the law of the land in the decision _Obergefell v. Hodges._ This ruling from 2015, that marriage is a fundamental right for every couple, was the culmination of decades of hard work from activists fighting for equal rights. Last year, we were able to further enshrine marriage equality into federal law with the passage of my bill, the _Respect for Marriage Act._ It passed with bipartisan support, and it’s one of my proudest accomplishments. **But Peter, despite all of this progress, attacks on LGBTQ rights are rampant across the country.** Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting transgender people and LGBTQ youth. And last year, in the devastating _Dobbs v. Jackson_ decision which overturned abortion access, **Justice Clarence Thomas called for _Obergefell v. Hodges_ to be “reconsidered.”** Building on the legacy of activists, like those who led the Stonewall Riots in 1969 and those who used the judicial system to make marriage equality the law of the land in 2015, I promise to keep up the fight for LGBTQ rights until every person can live freely, openly, and authentically. **[I’m keeping up the fight for LGBTQ rights every single day in the Senate, and I’m hoping you can pitch in to my reelection campaign before our quarterly deadline on Friday so we can keep building on the progress we’ve made toward equality.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jun23.CtqEq3&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20230626_PM2_V1_S1&t=4&akid=462%2E35263%2Ehwr5Iq)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2151?c0=tbe-em-jun23.0mNvpg&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20230626_PM2_V1_S1&t=5&akid=462%2E35263%2Ehwr5Iq)

| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/48407?t=6&akid=8735%2E878179%2EXEOeYJ) Happy Pride Month. I’m Will Rollins, a former federal prosecutor and gay Democrat running to flip California’s 41st Congressional District from red to blue.

[**In a moment, I’m going to ask you to split a $10 contribution between the Voter Protection Project and our campaign to help us win this race and expand LGBTQ+ representation in Congress, but first I’ll explain why this particular seat is so important.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/48407?t=7&akid=8735%2E878179%2EXEOeYJ)**

California’s 41st District is home to Palm Springs, and last fall, we made national headlines for going head-to-head in this district against a staunch opponent of LGTBQ+ rights, Ken Calvert. [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/48407?t=8&akid=8735%2E878179%2EXEOeYJ) When it comes to LGBTQ issues, Calvert’s as bad as it gets:

\- He opposed gay marriage.
\- He voted against allowing gay adoptions.
\- He voted down the Equality Act.
\- He voted to allow employers to fire employees for being LGBTQ+.
\- He voted against the repeal of _“Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell.”_

And if all of that isn’t bad enough, his first electoral victory came in 1994 after he sent out bright pink mailers outing his then political opponent and accused him of harboring a “secret” homosexual agenda.

**Now, the good news is Ken Calvert’s political career is more vulnerable than _ever before._**

In 2022, I ran against him as a first-time candidate with 0% name ID, and we handed him the closest midterm election he’s ever faced (just 4 points!). National experts say that our campaign was the #3 over-performing Democratic challenger campaign in the nation.

Now, in 2024, national Democrats are already calling our district one of 33 initial “offensive targets” to take back the House Majority.

So let’s make a strong statement this Pride Month, friend. Let’s send a staunch anti-LGBTQ+ Republican packing, flip this swing seat, and take back the House.

[**Pitch split a contribution of $10 or more between the Voter Protection Project and our campaign if you’re with me:**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/48407?t=9&akid=8735%2E878179%2EXEOeYJ) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Will Rollins and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/48408?t=10&akid=8735%2E878179%2EXEOeYJ)

Will Rollins**

body:
Please give me a moment to explain.
#
Peter,
When I launched this campaign to replace Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, I knew I had to do it the right way — without a cent from corporate PACs, shady mega-donors, or federal lobbyists.
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[chip in $10 or anything at all toward our goal of raising 30,000 individual donations before midnight on June 30.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34607?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n) But first, will you please give me just a moment to explain why that commitment is so important to me?**
**[Add a donation now →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34607?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n)**
For decades, massive corporations have turned the struggles of real everyday people into their own personal profit. Whether it’s wasting trillions of dollars on pointless forever wars or price-gouging medication millions of Americans need for survival — they’ve waged economic warfare on our country.
**And thanks to an army of lobbyists and millions in corporate PAC donations, the politicians who are supposed to protect us let them get away with it.**
These politicians will take money and buy stock from Big Pharma, fossil fuels, defense contractors, and so many other industries that have spent years tearing up our country. And once they’re elected, that’s who they’ll work for in Congress.
We’ve watched it happen over and over. Instead of fighting for us, corrupt DC politicians auction their votes off to the highest bidder while the people and communities they’re supposed to represent get left behind.
**I’m running to break that cycle.**
The only way we’ll be able to fight back and fundamentally change who has power in our country is by building an unprecedented grassroots movement here in Missouri — and with $0 from corporate PACs and $0 from federal lobbyists, we’re already on our way to making it happen.
**Thanks to support from real people just like you, we’re throwing out the rulebook and running this campaign the right way** — and our message is resonating. But we can’t slow down now.
The NRSC has already proved our race is a top target in 2024, and they’ll spend whatever it takes to keep Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate. **That’s why I’m asking:**
**[Will you add your first donation of $10 or more toward our goal of raising 30,000 individual donations before midnight on June 30? Your support right now will give us the resources to get our message in front of voters, stand up to the national Republicans backing Josh Hawley, and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat next year.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34607?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34608?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=4&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34608?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=5&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34608?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=6&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34608?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=7&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34608?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=8&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34608?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=9&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34607?refcode=em20230626-3321&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=3321%2E614464%2E3QSy0n)

body:
Help grow our campaign and make sure we're in a strong position ahead of our first-ever FEC deadline on Friday. | | |

Mark Levin Here.** Ever since 2020, it feels like things have changed. **If we learned anything from the global health crisis, it's that unexpected things can happen.** Governments and central banks sometimes do things that seem to cause more harm than good-like lockdowns and unprecedented money printing.We never thought "the powers that be" could go so far. When will they stop the political infighting and focus purely on what's best for the American people? We know excessive printing and spending negatively affect the value of the U.S. dollar and our retirement accounts.**It's clear, unexpected things can and will happen...and it's sometimes not the best for you and me.** As much as we've been through, _I don't think we're done. And I'm not sure anything can fix where we're at._ The problems are very simple and very clear. This is what we know...
* The U.S. dollar continues to buy less.
* The U.S. dollar could lose its global standing.
* Rising prices are throwing off household budgets.
* IRAs and 401(k)s lost almost as much value in 2022 as in the financial crisis, but no one's talking about it. **How did your accounts do?**
* And now the current administration wants four more years.

My question is, what's going to happen next?_We can no longer simply work hard, sock away money, watch our IRAs and 401(k)s grow, get a gold watch, and enjoy retirement._ No one knows what's next. subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWnnLenDmN

You are an informed citizen-I believe that wholeheartedly. You
love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S.
Constitution says

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWnnLenDmN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Good day,
fellow American.

You are
an informed citizen-I believe that wholeheartedly.

You love
this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S.
Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to
stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty
that define our nation.

Your
leadership and knowledge are needed today…

Do you
believe the American education system is failing millions of
young Americans?
YES
NO

We need
more citizens like you-informed citizens-because America is at a
turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold
thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the
Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism.

The
country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore
knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We
can't let that happen!

That's
why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of
Hillsdale College and our new, nationwide initiative-the CAMPAIGN
FOR INFORMED CITIZENS.

We are
the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and
teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal
of this new campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable
Americans who understand:

WHAT
the Constitution says
HOW
it relates to current issues and events
WHY
the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to
liberty

If this
campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the
Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people,
that our education system failed.

These are
young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just
haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history
in school.

You are
essential to the success of this effort to make America more
knowledgeable.

That's
because we're seeking 1,000 people in each state to help us teach
the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to
10,000,000 Americans in the coming year, and this initiative
starts with you-YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights.

And we
must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer
support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student
grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you
who want what's best for the country.

So
please, share your opinions by completing the National Survey on
the State of American Education today at the link below. Thank
you for reading my email!
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61965356:WnnLenDmN:m:3:2532013465:0A54C06D6080701526F31B7A73B6FE34:r

For our
children,

Bill
Gray, '01
Vice
President
National
Donor Outreach
Hillsdale
College

| | | The House voted twice to impeach Donald Trump, and with good reason. But now Kevin McCarthy and House Republicans are trying to "[expunge](https://default.salsalabs.org/T04a69303-3108-480e-9270-4a06975074e4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)" those votes, and pretend they never happened. [**Don't let them do it.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T543a1f61-b373-4928-9940-ed8f8d9aacfd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trying to re-write history this way may seem silly, but it's also dangerous. Trump's supporters already ignore reality on a regular basis, but allowing them to pretend Trump was never impeached takes this to a whole new level. [**Add your name, and demand the House vote against "erasing" Trump's impeachments.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcd136797-9556-4abb-bd48-1a1cd891cce8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

# Tuesday, JUNE 27, 2023
---|---
**Good morning!** Today we note that history repeats itself in odd ways. On this day in 1905, Russian sailors aboard the [battleship Potemkin](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuhDAMgOGnCVuQcSDAkKEL23XtiHLEgNtAEHEP8fZVO3f-h1_6Ph7jw3PkfXn3GzmZ0-gn4ReNYDW2Gs2IRXAzEZIpyFW2aztbd6YqVtfb2YQZGmOhR99XFAC6EJ6me9ZNH6hgh4AGLLbQNwht2VU4m976ZqKpqU2jaqDAks7yM_EuK83xTi86yyltRXSryJGVeVM4KByu6ypXzpLO-7crHHa6ssJh-xbeb512LSvppxeJlFc-9JGEti_edVWBvsmfWfslFacLx8UxcratqmHZPMe_o_wP8BMAAP__wnJdeQ) mutinied and called for the overthrow of Czar Nicholas. Their coup attempt failed. Now, on the same weekend 118 years later, another Russian mutiny has failed. June 27, 2023 Jim Himes just used his perch on the House Financial Services Committee to shill for his Democrat donor class, while he "questioned" Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen in a public hearing on our economic relations with China. See his play-acting video [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012v_1qg8GlCrZ8zG8Yw2a4w20c2sMi9VqS3PWtHqzDAWVdwk8vYR2Plo31VVl0hslPAj-KYfwKzHf6xLxX70tU_6OhDD38vywbQWQE15W40cKBVgSQJj1ZQuMQneeItFqKVlfT1jL0khstKcQ4VufWQ==&c=wPWBg2Bxc8Cx64hBQoeKVbYKvsPDnq33aWXCq28aK4-uE3y7HTMFCw==&ch=0XrVUIrKfXIexQvEV1d7Zj46uszpJJsxmfjG_IPlknwFs1s6I15-bg==). He and Yellen engage in a fine-tuned dance of the government Corporatists. Himes begins by disparaging principled criticism of the growing Chinese Communist Party (CCP) economic hegemony as mere "emotion" on the part of we critics. He begins to enumerate the brutal CCP atrocities on the Uyghurs, the spying, the hacking, the intellectual property theft, and with aplomb, dismisses it with "the list goes on and on." Himes said to Yellen "we must address the national security side without damaging the economic growth side" of the relationship. To Jim Himes, the cyber-driven and multi-pronged subversive cold-war the CCP is waging against the U.S. is a mere inconvenience, and should not interfere with the trade interests of the Democrat financial elite who have financed his campaigns for the past 14 years. In a verbal minuet with Yellen, she and Himes conveniently agree the U.S. should "de-risk" from China but no, no, no - not "de-couple." That public dance is nothing but a gratuitous head-nod to the concerns of average Americans, while being sure to get back to business protecting the economic interests of the crony-corporatist elites financing Democrat politicians from coast to coast. To Himes, right through the Obama years and now in concert with the Biden Administration, the preservation of American values, jobs, and even national security are continually undercut in favor of the financial and political elite. Jim Himes is their 'wing-man' on the Intelligence and Financial Services committees. And there's nothing the Biden team, with Himes' full-throated support, is doing to "de-risk" their engagement with the CCP. As Secretary of State Blinken's recent supplicating meeting with Xi Jinping illustrates, the stated totality of the Biden Administration's strategy entails writing letters and "monitoring." See video: [Blinken cowers](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012v_1qg8GlCrZ8zG8Yw2a4w20c2sMi9VqS3PWtHqzDAWVdwk8vYR2Plo31VVl0hslnCiS2vm83l6fKQshhA_Rmn2ZM10YBCCdZFUtD0ogEz7MiQ4GC5aS2AaL2PKOJjW0g1jWQusu-wvTj51Qitp2RQ==&c=wPWBg2Bxc8Cx64hBQoeKVbYKvsPDnq33aWXCq28aK4-uE3y7HTMFCw==&ch=0XrVUIrKfXIexQvEV1d7Zj46uszpJJsxmfjG_IPlknwFs1s6I15-bg==) The geopolitical tension was accelerated earlier this month when U.S. intelligence confirmed the Chinese are expanding their presence in Cuba to include both "eavesdropping" and "joint military training" facilities on Cuba's northern shore, some 90 miles from the Florida coast. Can we really expect that anything more than a stern memo from Blinken will follow? Such a facility is akin to the CCP having their aircraft carrier anchored permanently just off our shores. The implications of such a capability are game-changing: a quantum advancement in the CCP's electronic listening and detailed monitoring of our communications; perfect monitoring of our submarine entries and departures from our ports; capability to launch hypersonic missiles at, and across our mainland before they could be intercepted; sufficient proximity to launch a multi-faceted bio-warfare attack, "and on and on," as Mr. Himes would put it. If Jim Himes is simpatico with the Biden Administration in its 'engagement' approach to China, where is that course likely to lead? If we look over the horizon a bit, we can see how this CCP gambit can, in fact, 'change the game.' Should the CCP be successful in smooth-talking Biden and Blinken, while they expeditiously complete the Cuban facility, they will have emplaced a valuable new piece on the geopolitical chessboard. As the cries from our body politic to "do something" about the military facility, reach even the seemingly impenetrable ears of the Biden Administration, the CCP will be positioned to extract an exorbitant price - i.e. the coerced withdrawal of U.S. support facilities on Taiwan in exchange for the CCP's abandonment of its Cuban outpost! We'll see. Jim Himes fails to appreciate the strategy of the Chinese Communists... or maybe he does. He should read my analysis of the Chinese long strategy recently published in The Connecticut Centinal: [Chinese Execute an Historic 'Flip-the-Script'](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012v_1qg8GlCrZ8zG8Yw2a4w20c2sMi9VqS3PWtHqzDAWVdwk8vYR2Plo31VVl0hslr62sYRNwRk_3JnlHaOG7mxaIi1YyZIWZ1fVfjnTfL9VavdVIeX9kAq78HnEd65Wj0JUeZHxu2E3Nw1xjXNvfANf-wxjzAWVWvHuV30tIVndTrY8sAvbon6m2UNBh33reAZ0ZC2e736NluPtwLJ4m3oQFaSGWJTP4Gdk8VrRE9qI=&c=wPWBg2Bxc8Cx64hBQoeKVbYKvsPDnq33aWXCq28aK4-uE3y7HTMFCw==&ch=0XrVUIrKfXIexQvEV1d7Zj46uszpJJsxmfjG_IPlknwFs1s6I15-bg==)
Forget your donors, Mr. Himes - the correct answer is 'de-couple'! To invoke an historic quote, "there are years when nothing happens - then there are months when decades happen" - we just had one..........

**Myth:** Pesticides aren’t dangerous, and we need them in agriculture to feed the world.
**Fact:** Pesticides can be detrimental and even lethal to bees -- and we don’t need these toxic products to grow our food.
Without bees and other pollinators, our food system would be in _serious danger._ Many of your favorite fruits, vegetables and nuts could become extremely difficult and expensive to find -- and the pesticides used to grow them could end up in you and your loved ones’ bodies, too. [**Act now to help eliminate toxic pesticides from our food system before the damage is irreversible: Donate $27 or more to Friends of the Earth now!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1845349?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
There’s no mystery here, Friend. Study after study has found that the massive use of pesticides, like Bayer-Monsanto's bee-toxic neonicotinoids, are key drivers in the decimation of pollinators. **But the EPA could still approve neonics for another 15 years! **
The clock is ticking. If we don’t ban neonics soon, we could be facing a second Silent Spring with dire consequences for our food system and the planet. Pollinators need your support now.
**Help get bee-toxic neonics out of our food system once and for all. Donate $27 now and help Friends of the Earth reach our $5,320 goal!**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1845345?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1845348?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Bees are an essential part of our ecosystems and way of life. We rely on bees and other pollinators for 75% of the world's food crops, including some of the most nutritious. If we lose bees, we will also lose many of the foods that keep us healthy!
In fact, the decline in bees and other pollinators has already harmed global fruit, vegetable, and nut production. Without access to these vital crops and a healthy diet, _**people could be at higher risk of heart disease, stroke, diabetes, and even cancer**_ , according to a recent study.
Neonics can directly hurt people, too. They can make their way into the very food you eat and have been linked to health impacts like **birth defects of the heart and brain, hormone disruption, and autism.**
If we don’t act now to ban bee-killing pesticides, our food system, our health, and our planet could face devastating consequences. Today’s children could be some of the last people to share the planet with many species of wild bees.
The damage being done is clear. But pesticide giants like Bayer-Monsanto continue to funnel big money into disinformation efforts. They are denying and distracting from the role that their products play in bee deaths. They have gotten away with this for years, and our bees, our health, and our planet are paying for the consequences. Now is the time to stand up and demand action!
**Help stop vulnerable bees from vanishing, and protect our planet. Make your $27 donation to Friends of the Earth today.**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1845345?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1845347?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1845348?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Pesticides like neonics can kill bees on contact.** But even if they survive, these toxic chemicals can attack bees’ nerve cells and can harm their cognition, flight ability, and even reproduction -- making it harder for them to survive.
The EPA has a chance to ban neonics once and for all. Instead, **it might approve these pesticides for another 15 years and subject even more bees to this fate.** But there's still hope, Friend. Because of supporters like you, we have the chance to make real change -- change that would help protect bees, people, and the planet.
At Friends of the Earth, we are doing everything we can to help save pollinators, protect our health, and stop the destruction of our planet. We're working to ban toxic pesticides that are driving the decline of bees and butterflies. At the same time, we're pushing major grocery companies like Kroger to stop selling food grown with these chemicals.
We won’t stand by and let corporate greed trump the health of pollinators, people, and the planet. With your membership support today, we can double down on these efforts and give pollinators and our planet a fighting chance! Please, Friend, will you donate $27 or more today and help us reach our $5,320 goal for pollinators and the planet?
**Bees, people, and the planet are on the line. Rush your $27 donation and help us reach our $5,320 goal before midnight tonight!**

name: Costello for Senate Newsletter
subject: Costello for Senate Campaign Update
body:
Dear Friend,

Just a brief note to provide you with statements on two important issues
recently debated by Maine's legislature: gun violence and tribal
sovereignty. Both of these statements are also posted on our website (
www.costelloforsenate.com), so feel free to take a look at them there, as
well as share them with anyone you think might be interested. Additionally,
those wishing to donate to our campaign are encouraged to do so by this
Friday's Federal Election Commission (FEC) reporting deadline.

Thank you,
Grace

*Democratic Senate Candidate David Costello Says an All the Above
Approach Would Likely Work Best to Tackle Gun Violence in the United States*

Like many Mainers, I grew up learning to hunt and shoot and to handle guns
safely and responsibly. I took gun safety very seriously then and, given
the long-standing rise in gun violence, I take it even more seriously
today. When people talk of gun safety today, hunting, target shooting, and
gun ownership are seldom, if ever, really at issue. At issue is the
proliferation in the sale and violent misuse of non-hunting guns and
magazines and the counterproductive weakening and rejection of laws
designed to reduce gun violence.

While I would never support denying responsible, law-abiding citizens their
right to own a gun, I do support markedly strengthening our nation’s gun
safety laws and regulations. Gun violence is on the rise throughout the
United States, and appallingly, since 2020, it has surpassed car accidents
as the leading cause of death for American children. The fact that the U.S.
House and Senate have done little over the last 30 years to address gun
violence is unconscionable. Everything that can be done - from expanded
mental health services, stricter gun crime sentencing, and increased
community policing to waiting periods, universal background checks, and
assault weapons bans – should be done to reduce gun-related deaths,
injuries, and crime in the United States. Most Americans agree. To continue
to do less is unacceptable.

*Democratic U.S. Senate Candidate David Costello Urges Support for Tribal
Sovereignty for Maine’s Four Indigenous Tribes*

Brunswick – Democratic Senate Candidate David Costello today released a
statement urging support for tribal sovereignty for Maine’s four indigenous
tribes. Costello stated, “unlike the Nation’s other 570 federally
recognized tribes, Maine’s Penobscot, Maliseet, Mi’kmaq, and Passamaquoddy
tribes are unnecessarily and detrimentally excluded from automatically
receiving a range of federal health care, economic development,
environmental protection, emergency response assistance, and other
benefits.”

Costello noted that a recent Harvard University study concluded that tribal
self-determination and government has contributed to significant economic
growth and other benefits for the vast majority of other indigenous tribes
in the United States. Additionally, and significantly for many rural towns
and villages in Maine, the study also concluded that there were significant
spill-over benefits for neighboring non-tribal communities.

Costello added that the study found:

“Unique to Maine, the federal Maine Indian Claims Settlement Act of 1980
(MICSA) empowers the state government to block the applicability of federal
Indian policy in Maine. As a result, the development of the Wabanaki
Nations’ economies and governmental capacities have been stunted. Today,
all four of the tribes in Maine—Maliseet, Mi’kmaq, Passamaquoddy, and
Penobscot—are stark economic underperformers relative to the other tribes
in the Lower 48 states.

The subjugation of the Wabanaki Nation’s self-governing capacities is
blocking economic development to the detriment of both tribal and
non-tribal citizens, alike. For the tribal citizens of Maine held down by
MICSA’s restrictions, loosening or removing those restrictions offers them
little in the way of downside risks and but much in the way of upside
payoffs.

Importantly, we find in this study that “nowhere to go but up” also applies
to the Maine state government and Maine’s non-tribal citizens. From case
after case, the pattern that has emerged under federal policies of tribal
self-determination through self-government is one in which tribal economic
development spills over positively into neighboring non-tribal communities
and improves the abilities of state and local governments to serve their
citizens.”

Costello concluded, “As the study emphasizes, there is ‘nowhere to go but
up’ for Maine and Maine communities and thus there is unlikely to be any
downside to granting tribal sovereignty to Maine’s four tribes. Moreover,
it’s the right thing to do morally and ethically.”

name: Shift WA
subject: Why Shift? Our interviews.
body:
We recently had the opportunity to interview Kyle Mann, the editor-in-chief of The Babylon Bee, a renowned conservative satirical website. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61941774:W7AWUnDNI:m:1:2610672541:F7D04EFF6BBD909B193B4AD21F346F91:r "Shift Washington")
---
|
Friends, Recently, we had the opportunity to interview Kyle Mann, the editor-in-chief of The Babylon Bee, a renowned conservative satirical website. The Babylon Bee gained national attention in early 2022, when Twitter banned the site for posting a light-hearted spoof about Dr. Rachel Levine, a transgender woman serving as the U.S. Assistant Secretary of Health. The incident sparked deep concerns over censorship on social media platforms and cancel culture. During the interview, Mann addressed the Twitter ban and its profound impact on The Babylon Bee's circulation - _hint: it had a very positive effect!_ He also shared his thoughts on various topics, including Elon Musk, the attack on free speech by liberals, and the criteria for choosing satire targets. In his trademark humorous style, Mann humorously stated future plans for the website, such as getting banned from Facebook and even encouraging Elon Musk to purchase the platform! Our interview with Mann is just one example of the unique - and valuable - work we do here at Shift WA. **And we are on a mission to expand our reach!** That's where your help comes in. [**Will you help us spread the word about our work by sharing our interview with Kyle Mann, Editor-in-Chief of The Babylon Bee on your Facebook profile?**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61941775:W7AWUnDNI:m:1:2610672541:F7D04EFF6BBD909B193B4AD21F346F91:r) Simply [**click here**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61941775:W7AWUnDNI:m:1:2610672541:F7D04EFF6BBD909B193B4AD21F346F91:r) to share our interview on Facebook. With your help, we can reach more readers and increase our impact on our state! | | | I’m at my wits’ end, Friend.

Biden and the Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising war chest. Now their sights are set on me.

At this point, if I don’t do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will I lose my House seat, Republicans may never hold the majority in Congress again.
**Friend, this is Ryan Zinke. I served as President Trump’s Secretary of the Interior and I was the commander at SEAL Team 6.**
**I’m also running for Congress in the most critical race in the nation.**
But if Biden can destroy me in this race, I can guarantee you no other Republican will have a chance.
**In 2022, I lead the team of Navy SEAL’s that retook the House Majority, and I have more battle experience than anyone else. Point is, I’m one of the toughest, most battle-tested Republicans in Washington D.C. If I can’t beat the Democrats gunning for my seat - no one can.**

I’m humbly asking you, as a warrior who’s fought for this nation for my entire life, will you help me out?

---

You have my word, as a former Navy SEAL and commander at SEAL Team 6, if you help me out, I will continue to return the favor in Congress.

Thank you for your support,
Ryan Zinke

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.
---

Contributions from corporations, foreign nationals (without "green cards"), federal government contractors, and national banks are prohibited. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer for each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in a calendar year. The maximum that an individual may contribute is $6,600 ($3,300/primary & $3,300/general). The maximum that a couple using a joint account may contribute is $13,200 ($6,600/primary & $6,600/general). A federal multi-candidate PAC may contribute $10,000 ($5,000/primary & $5,000/general). Contribution rules
* I am a U.S. citizen or lawfully admitted permanent resident (i.e., green card holder).
* This contribution is made from my own funds, and funds are not being provided to me by another person or entity for the purpose of making this contribution.
* I am making this contribution with my own personal credit card and not with a corporate or business credit card or a card issued to another person.
* I am at least eighteen years old. I am not, nor am I making this contribution on behalf of, a corporation, labor organization, national bank, foreign national without a green card, a federal contractor, or any other federally impermissible source.

Ron DeSantis was a member of the United States Navy. Use of his military rank, job titles and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

Dear Friend, Populism is nothing new to world history. While it
can be easy to think about American politics as being divided
between the Left and the Right, the reality is much different.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWArDRnDNz

Dear
Friend,
Populism
is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think
about American politics as being divided between the Left and the
Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been
seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat
and Republican establishment.

And
believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back
to Roman times.

That's
why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to
make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks:
Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson.

Hanson is
a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think
you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important
eBook, you'll learn more about:

What
we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that
rebel against both the establishment-and each other.
The
important parallels between these ancient movements and their
modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative
populism.
What
lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our
culture.

You can
get your free copy of Dueling Populisms using this secure link:
https://resources.hoover.org/dueling-populisms-signup/.

And
please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It's
important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them
to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

You can
use this link to get access to your free eBook right now.

Thanks,
Greg

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Can I get your thoughts on religious liberty in America?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zroo7smeg0ap98keon6234aenh37qv2422bsuu58_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3geap35cph2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7hi45tbb3jrqvvbhrhpp52t7n7ss3r3hpb1r8ao_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3geap35cph2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zshdk0i9i9cuimkgmh1d0b4m5dp0ks5d8tqh6qm8_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3geap35cph2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zai9sb1t0j34lctbtbfjdlifa1at4ootou4apflg_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3geap35cph2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

**And if attacking a woman’s right to choose wasn’t enough, the radical right is attacking so many western Pennsylvania values:** Threatening to take away our hard earned benefits like Social Security, attacking the VA and holding veterans’ benefits hostage, coming for LGBTQ+ children and their parents, turning their backs on working folks to appease their billionaire backers, and so much more.

**I’m not afraid to fight the GOP, Derek. But standing up for what is right is exactly why they’re targeting me so hard. In fact, election experts are already calling PA-17 one of the most competitive races in the country.**

**I know our people-powered campaign has what it takes to win again._But only if we all work together._**

[**Derek, this is a grassroots-funded campaign, so I’m counting on you to help power us to victory. Can you chip in $15 or whatever you can today to help us hit our goal before the month ends?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65480003/413568276/-954707654?refcode=em_fr_2023.06.27_b1_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDE5MjE1MC1lZDE0LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BD-DHC67x8el-739yfdTQi_p6UzhPUCwNdHbBMrY68w=)

subject: The Bone In Her Leg Shattered - But This Saved Her Life
body:
When Karen was on a trip as a Scout Leader she never expected that bones inside of her left leg would shatter into 14 pieces.

When Karen was on a trip as a Scout Leader she never expected that bones inside of her left leg would shatter into 14 pieces.
Nor could have predicted that after her bones splintered... and mixed around in blood and muscle... That her broken leg would **_send her into shock_** and cause her body temperature to plummet dangerously low.
But that's what happened one fateful autumn afternoon in August off the coast of Maine.
Fortunately one of the other scout leaders was smart enough to have an [Emergency Sleeping Bag with him.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27599%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Y7ORp1nVU4EuwuhAjArZVw&sysid=1)
As Karen's life hung in the balance, and as **her core body temperature fell dangerously low** , he got her inside this small and lightweight bag.
Within minutes the Emergency Sleeping Bag helped bring her temperature back up.
That's because these miracle survival tools trap 90% of your body heat and reflect it back on to you.
By the time the paramedics made it Karen was doing much better. **Her leg still hurt, but her life was no longer in danger.**
Friend, the Emergency Sleeping Bag is the most underrated survival tool of all time.
And today you can get one for over 50% off.
Here's why.
First off, temperatures are still warm in many places right now, and while we sell these at a steady clip in the winter... sales are slower in warmer months.
So, we need to get them off the shelves.
Secondly, we're about to redo the logo on our Emergency Sleeping Bag.
And to clear out the product inventory of the non-logo version we're going to give them away **_50% off_** to whoever wants one.
**Hurry and claim yours NOW.**
We only have a few hundred left. And as this email is going to 87,551 other customers they're sure to fly off the shelf!

Hello there,
I have to admit, even six months in, I'm still in awe that the boy I sent to military school is now the man I call governor.
When Wes first told me he wanted to run for governor, I knew he faced serious challenges. He was the underdog, a first-time candidate going up against career politicians who'd spent decades building their influence. I worried folks would only see the boy he was, not the man he's become.
But I also knew he had the drive and the heart to win. Because I saw those same qualities when he graduated from military school, served as an officer in Afghanistan, became the first Black Rhodes scholar at John Hopkins University, launched his small business, and led one of the nation's largest poverty-fighting organization.
**And now I see him putting that same drive and heart to work for the people of Maryland every day. I'll admit to being biased, but I think he's doing an amazing job.**
I'm reaching out because while Wes has been working hard for all of us, it's meant he hasn't had much time to fundraise. And his team tells me that while our goals are much more modest than they were a year ago, it's still important that we hit them so we can keep moving Maryland forward.
[**There are only 3 days left this month, and the team has shared that we still need to raise $6,491 before the end-of-quarter deadline on June 30. clean_body: | | = Hello there, I have to admit, even six months in, I'm still in awe that the boy I sent to military school is now the man I call governor. When Wes first told me he wanted to run for governor, I knew he faced serious challenges. He was the underdog, a first-time candidate going up against career politicians who'd spent decades building their influence. I worried folks would only see the boy he was, not the man he's become. But I also knew he had the drive and the heart to win. Because I saw those same qualities when he graduated from military school, served as an officer in Afghanistan, became the first Black Rhodes scholar at John Hopkins University, launched his small business, and led one of the nation's largest poverty-fighting organization. And now I see him putting that same drive and heart to work for the people of Maryland every day. I'll admit to being biased, but I think he's doing an amazing job. I'm reaching out because while Wes has been working hard for all of us, it's meant he hasn't had much time to fundraise. And his team tells me that while our goals are much more modest than they were a year ago, it's still important that we hit them so we can keep moving Maryland forward. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = | = ---|---|--- = | = | = With gratitude, Joy Thomas Moore = | Wes Moore is a combat veteran, Rhodes Scholar, former small business owner, and leader of one of the nation’s largest poverty-fighting organizations — and now, your governor! clean_body: Time and again, Nick delivers. | | | | Peter, Lately we've seen a lot of fundraising emails hit our inboxes. That Federal Elections Commission end-of-quarter fundraising deadline is looming, and everyone — Nick included — needs to show strong numbers. Something that seems to be missing from so many of these messages is the 'why.' Not just why we need to fundraise or why now — but what drives the candidate and their team to do this work. So today, I want to share my 'why.' The race for the CA-30 Congressional seat is hot. There's no shortage of candidates to work with, but Nick's background stood out to me immediately. Right now, the most important battles for our civil rights are currently taking place in the courtroom and the classroom. Nick has experience advocating for progress in both. = = Fresh out of college, Nick dove into teaching. His time at Markham Middle School in Watts gave him a first hand look at our nation's potential: hardworking, caring, brilliant, creative, and full of energy. On the flip side, he saw students struggle with things entirely out of their control. From income inequality, difficulty accessing health care, racism, food insecurity, environmental injustice, housing instability, to a broken criminal justice system, and of course, underfunded public education, these kids were expected to overcome so much. When he realized how he could help resolve these systemic issues, he uprooted his life to attend law school, became a lawyer, ran for the LAUSD school board to push Los Angeles schools to better serve all kids, and got to work removing the obstacles adults had thrown in students' way. As a teacher, civil rights lawyer, and school board member, Nick's seen the daily effect of public policy on our children. His perspective is critical to the conversations about the future of public education, the barriers children face, and ensuring equitable access to opportunities. Now, Nick's working to bring that experience in the classroom and the courtroom to Congress — and we can make sure he gets there, Peter. I'm proud to be on Team Nick — and thousands of people have already joined our movement. Together, we can elect a Congress ready to make the bold changes our communities – and our students – deserve. = Mark Hatton Team Nick | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Nick Melvoin for Congress - FEC ID #C00831289 |

Peter, I believe that our elected officials ought to be looking out for the families in their districts, but the massive corporations passing out fat checks have an outsized influence in our halls of power. This is flat-out wrong, and I’m running for Congress to change it.
Our government should work for the people, not massive corporations. That’s why I’ve never taken a dime of corporate PAC money and why I’ve announced that I never will.
With less than three days to our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, I’m hoping you can chip in to keep up our momentum to flip this seat blue and replace far-right extremist Lauren Boebert once and for all.
I’m asking, will you contribute what you can to our grassroots-powered campaign to elect a strong pro-choice woman to represent the people of Western and Southern Colorado? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2306_q2_eoq?refcode2=link_CTA]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Look, I don’t have a personal fortune to foot the bill for my campaign. And you know what? We need more people at the table who understand what it’s like to struggle. That’s why I’m proud that we will get this done with the help of folks like you chipping in what they can when they can.
We have a critical federal fundraising deadline on Friday and just a few days to meet our goal. Will you join me in this fight today and chip in whatever you can to fuel our people-powered campaign to flip this seat blue and replace “ultra MAGA” Lauren Boebert once and for all? Let’s make this happen,
Debby

name: James O'Keefe
subject: Their final attack on me . . .
body:
14 years ago, I founded an organization from my parent’s home with the intent of using undercover investigative journalism to expose the corrupt.

| | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zg3dmipg37t3pcica23mbf10d3ng1brq72v0kpvo_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zs8v8lskp7jbnf0cu1oaht7ae794hlgh46na523o_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)
Dear Friend,

Fourteen years ago, I founded an organization from my parent’s home with the intent of using undercover investigative journalism to expose the corrupt.

You’ve seen my work. Most Americans have.

In February, after releasing a historic investigation on Pfizer, the Board of Directors of the organization I created from scratch, ousted me.

It was a blow, but things happen for a reason. Today, I’m unleashed to do my work through my new organization, OMG, without any obstruction and **no one to stop me.**

Since I was fired, I’ve chosen not to look back. I want to move forward with my work, with happiness and spirit. **And I move forward carrying with me the many lessons I learned.**

Those 14 years were formative.

When I started, my hands would tremble when I confronted a target of my investigations. It took time, but I overcame my fears of confrontation by grounding myself in principle.

I learned about trust, loyalty, and leadership.

Most importantly, I learned the hard way the true depth of Michael Jordan’s quote on leadership: “Winning has a price. **And leadership has a price**.”

I’ve been sued for exposing the truth more times than I can count. And, get this, **yesterday, I was sued in federal court by the very organization I founded.**

In my opinion, their intent is to shut me down now that they no longer have any control over me.

And this lawsuit is going to cost me a fortune! That’s why I’m writing you today to **[ask for your support to my legal defense fund.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zn9gvn4h58egalvt8mmefp51986lkl18q5tcmnoo_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)**

My friends with the non-profit, Liberty Guard, have set up **[the fund to pay attorney costs](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zf2blgg8c82sdelednrg3odv6mskgpamqu7nn5b0_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)** that will quickly pile up.

As I mentioned, this isn’t my first rodeo so I know that **the cost will exceed $500,000**.

Good attorneys aren’t cheap, and my pockets are not deep.

No one gets wealthy doing the work that I do. Trust me.

That’s where you come in. **[Will you chip in and help me defend myself](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhe5ojf4bisq541k5aqhk5c67nmhqmau065ens98_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)?**

When you do, I’ll be following up as the case progresses but I’ll also keep you informed of the great work I’m doing at OMG . . . and it’s exciting!

A fresh start, being forced to start over, I’ll admit is thrilling. And I’m starting armed with all of the lessons I’ve learned to avoid the pitfalls I’ve experienced.

Me and my teams are more efficient, we’re more productive, and our work hits like a sledgehammer.

But my work will be silenced if my former employer gets their way. Or the distractions of a court battle and its costs may become overwhelming.

**[I’m asking you to STAND UP FOR ME, so I can keep working](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvq9rrlagkrklqrlroehclio61bi4r0c9b9dgggg_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)**. And I’ll commit to you that **I will NOT let you down**.

So please, **[make a donation to my legal defense fund through Liberty Guard](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9jvi5216ctqar9j7mbd590ecnetvecq09kaovdg_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)**. We have a long way to do to hit our goal, so please, donate as much as you can.

Thank you for your direct or indirect support over the years. Your views, donations or simply talking about my work to friends and family has kept me going for 14 years . . . **and we cannot stop now!**

Respectfully,

James O’Keefe

P.S. I have 20 days to file my response to the lawsuit. I have to raise enough money to pay for a retainer and cover the legal work to defend against this lawsuit. This is unfortunately urgent so please, **[donate today](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4pf415ltngtlpbathpll1pakpk1m4u2k4laoqmo_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)**.

Trust me. That’s where you come in. ? When you do, I’ll be following up as the case progresses but I’ll also keep you informed of the great work I’m doing at OMG . . . and it’s exciting! A fresh start, being forced to start over, I’ll admit is thrilling. And I’m starting armed with all of the lessons I’ve learned to avoid the pitfalls I’ve experienced. Me and my teams are more efficient, we’re more productive, and our work hits like a sledgehammer. But my work will be silenced if my former employer gets their way. Or the distractions of a court battle and its costs may become overwhelming. . And I’ll commit to you that I will NOT let you down. So please, . We have a long way to do to hit our goal, so please, donate as much as you can. Thank you for your direct or indirect support over the years. Your views, donations or simply talking about my work to friends and family has kept me going for 14 years . . . and we cannot stop now! Respectfully, James O’Keefe P.S. I have 20 days to file my response to the lawsuit. I have to raise enough money to pay for a retainer and cover the legal work to defend against this lawsuit. This is unfortunately urgent so please, . ICYMI News 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 |

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Can I get your thoughts on religious liberty in America?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhmn2la1b7j2j8v3td0s28v8hsiplg65rk9baen8_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkhlfehg8lof20dbjgl811e6k4c5r6p7njsds558_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zeh29com22sbiq167rcpmsjag42gfhcknnl0t710_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfo29l2bnust2736c6lj2rovkgh7rfdghrppfhg8_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ge9pr6cph2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

| | **Friend, this past weekend, we successfully reopened Interstate 95 to traffic, restoring our region's most important economic artery in record time.** The morning of the I-95 collapse, I was on the phone with the White House and Governor to make sure that federal funding was flowing as soon as possible to get the roadway fixed. **Within 24 hours, repair work had begun as I toured the site with federal officials.** I'm proud of the collaboration that saw federal, state and local officials mobilize to ensure that a very challenging situation was handled with as little difficulty as possible. **This collapse could've meant months of debilitating delays and traffic nightmares. Working together, we've made sure that did not happen.**
---
| | **THIS is what government should be about: working to deliver results for those we serve, and cutting through partisan gridlock and red tape to make it happen.**
---
**Since being elected to Congress, I've had one goal: deliver for the constituents and Philadelphia neighborhoods I serve, and over the past couple weeks, that goal is what has motivated me, as well as state and local partners to work together to get this done.
** **Simply put, my aim is and will always be to improve the lives of those I represent,** and as I continue toward 2024, I hope that you will continue to support the work I do for Philadelphia, so we can keep moving our city forward.
Sincerely, Congressman Brendan Boyle

| | Here’s the deal about our huge FEC deadline on Friday: **_it’s a make or break moment for Democrats in Georgia._**

We’ve seen our numbers consistently dropping over the last couple months ahead of this deadline, and we’ve tried to sound the alarm.

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z966fkts8mnq3b7fkb4bgqauastreu2omfb9elho_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie8pb4cjh2bs)
Dear Friend,

Fourteen years ago, I founded an organization from my parent’s home with the intent of using undercover investigative journalism to expose the corrupt.

You’ve seen my work. Most Americans have.

In February, after releasing a historic investigation on Pfizer, the Board of Directors of the organization I created from scratch, ousted me.

It was a blow, but things happen for a reason. Today, I’m unleashed to do my work through my new organization, OMG, without any obstruction and **no one to stop me.**

Since I was fired, I’ve chosen not to look back. I want to move forward with my work, with happiness and spirit. **And I move forward carrying with me the many lessons I learned.**

Those 14 years were formative.

When I started, my hands would tremble when I confronted a target of my investigations. It took time, but I overcame my fears of confrontation by grounding myself in principle.

I learned about trust, loyalty, and leadership.

Most importantly, I learned the hard way the true depth of Michael Jordan’s quote on leadership: “Winning has a price. **And leadership has a price**.”

I’ve been sued for exposing the truth more times than I can count. And, get this, **yesterday, I was sued in federal court by the very organization I founded.**

In my opinion, their intent is to shut me down now that they no longer have any control over me.

And this lawsuit is going to cost me a fortune! That’s why I’m writing you today to **[ask for your support to my legal defense fund.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ze8f5gos65pe1644djeepujcebnu1sccu759v42g_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie8pb4cjh2bs)**

My friends with the non-profit, Liberty Guard, have set up **[the fund to pay attorney costs](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5ptu0o77861lch2b5uvutnmtb7gbcvj5769t5qg_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie8pb4cjh2bs)** that will quickly pile up.

As I mentioned, this isn’t my first rodeo so I know that **the cost will exceed $500,000**.

Good attorneys aren’t cheap, and my pockets are not deep.

No one gets wealthy doing the work that I do. Trust me.

That’s where you come in. **[Will you chip in and help me defend myself](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zudgkbi9pqs9b442mtavr774jajnl5i9l476pvkg_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie8pb4cjh2bs)?**

When you do, I’ll be following up as the case progresses but I’ll also keep you informed of the great work I’m doing at OMG . . . and it’s exciting!

A fresh start, being forced to start over, I’ll admit is thrilling. And I’m starting armed with all of the lessons I’ve learned to avoid the pitfalls I’ve experienced.

Me and my teams are more efficient, we’re more productive, and our work hits like a sledgehammer.

But my work will be silenced if my former employer gets their way. Or the distractions of a court battle and its costs may become overwhelming.

**[I’m asking you to STAND UP FOR ME, so I can keep working](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zi7shf68cb509sm3cd09jujifsf7pkpmbu7kfnj0_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie8pb4cjh2bs)**. And I’ll commit to you that **I will NOT let you down**.

So please, **[make a donation to my legal defense fund through Liberty Guard](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z21mifg83tdsdv2u0thrnuk7ui4h4rcai3cv7foo_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie8pb4cjh2bs)**. We have a long way to do to hit our goal, so please, donate as much as you can.

Thank you for your direct or indirect support over the years. Your views, donations or simply talking about my work to friends and family has kept me going for 14 years . . . **and we cannot stop now!**

Respectfully,

James O’Keefe

P.S. I have 20 days to file my response to the lawsuit. I have to raise enough money to pay for a retainer and cover the legal work to defend against this lawsuit. This is unfortunately urgent so please, **[donate today](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zg7tchcedbg3fvie4lvdfcnr3o3k35886hakpego_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie8pb4cjh2bs)**.
