name: Craig Segall, Evergreen
subject: Tell IRS: Don't use taxpayer dollars to undercut clean energy
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN COLLABORATIVE
body:
We can't let death and taxes come for the grid
| | | | | [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/3139?t=2&akid=13454%2E53494%2E9b8f2V)
---
| | Friend, My name is Craig Segall, and I'm honored to join the Evergreen team as vice president of policy. As I roll up my sleeves and get to work here in our collective fight for a thriving and inclusive clean energy future, I wanted to let you know about an upcoming IRS decision that could create a "doom loop" for climate. **_Here's what’s at stake:_** If new IRS guidance on the hydrogen tax credit within the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) isn't clear about what makes hydrogen truly "clean," **billions of dollars in taxpayer money meant to speed up the clean energy transition could instead go towards increasing climate pollution.**
Fossil fuel industry lobbyists are dominating the conversation, which is why **[climate activists like you need to be even louder.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/IRS-hydrogen-clean-energy-comments/?source=ema_2023_06_27_hydrogen-IRS&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100clean&utm_source=email2023_06_27&t=3&akid=13454%2E53494%2E9b8f2V)**
---
[**TELL IRS: STOP DIRTY HYDROGEN****FROM DERAILING CLEAN ENERGY**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/IRS-hydrogen-clean-energy-comments/?source=ema_2023_06_27_hydrogen-IRS&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100clean&utm_source=email2023_06_27&t=5&akid=13454%2E53494%2E9b8f2V)
---
Hydrogen, used right, can help us decarbonize entire industrial sectors. But if we produce it with dirty fossil power, it can increase carbon pollution emissions by hundreds of millions of tons. Done correctly, the new hydrogen energy should instead lift up clean power and help shut down fossil power—**but that all depends on how IRS defines "clean" hydrogen in the fine print.** We can't let death and taxes come for the grid. [**Submit a comment right now to make sure that IRS does not undercut our race for clean energy.**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/IRS-hydrogen-clean-energy-comments/?source=ema_2023_06_27_hydrogen-IRS&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100clean&utm_source=email2023_06_27&t=6&akid=13454%2E53494%2E9b8f2V)
---
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/IRS-hydrogen-clean-energy-comments/?source=ema_2023_06_27_hydrogen-IRS&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=100clean&utm_source=email2023_06_27&t=8&akid=13454%2E53494%2E9b8f2V)
---
Onward, Craig SegallVice President of Policy Evergreen Collaborative

name: James O'Keefe
subject: Their final attack on me . . .
body:
14 years ago, I founded an organization from my parent’s home with the intent of using undercover investigative journalism to expose the corrupt.

| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zia5qpogtnjvb995vfq5k5ctaqasb4acg4blq318_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie4ob6c3h2bs)
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpaf7i3q24tqumfkg2hfu2aph59hl1n05cf81olg_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie4ob6c3h2bs)
Dear Friend,

Fourteen years ago, I founded an organization from my parent’s home with the intent of using undercover investigative journalism to expose the corrupt.

You’ve seen my work. Most Americans have.

In February, after releasing a historic investigation on Pfizer, the Board of Directors of the organization I created from scratch, ousted me.

It was a blow, but things happen for a reason. Today, I’m unleashed to do my work through my new organization, OMG, without any obstruction and **no one to stop me.**

Since I was fired, I’ve chosen not to look back. I want to move forward with my work, with happiness and spirit. **And I move forward carrying with me the many lessons I learned.**

Those 14 years were formative.

When I started, my hands would tremble when I confronted a target of my investigations. It took time, but I overcame my fears of confrontation by grounding myself in principle.

I learned about trust, loyalty, and leadership.

Most importantly, I learned the hard way the true depth of Michael Jordan’s quote on leadership: “Winning has a price. **And leadership has a price**.”

I’ve been sued for exposing the truth more times than I can count. And, get this, **yesterday, I was sued in federal court by the very organization I founded.**

In my opinion, their intent is to shut me down now that they no longer have any control over me.

And this lawsuit is going to cost me a fortune! That’s why I’m writing you today to **[ask for your support to my legal defense fund.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zc2dn0aqqj0ahjjrm86ue71n5h1nof825effttno_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie4ob6c3h2bs)**

My friends with the non-profit, Liberty Guard, have set up **[the fund to pay attorney costs](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmhg42kd55fkd5cqp5o0oqfgk49dqkf239oboigo_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie4ob6c3h2bs)** that will quickly pile up.

As I mentioned, this isn’t my first rodeo so I know that **the cost will exceed $500,000**.

Good attorneys aren’t cheap, and my pockets are not deep.

No one gets wealthy doing the work that I do. Trust me.

That’s where you come in. **[Will you chip in and help me defend myself](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zki9ip10f1d3rrbrqimhdneti4iiiagdrat76afo_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie4ob6c3h2bs)?**

When you do, I’ll be following up as the case progresses but I’ll also keep you informed of the great work I’m doing at OMG . . . and it’s exciting!

A fresh start, being forced to start over, I’ll admit is thrilling. And I’m starting armed with all of the lessons I’ve learned to avoid the pitfalls I’ve experienced.

Me and my teams are more efficient, we’re more productive, and our work hits like a sledgehammer.

But my work will be silenced if my former employer gets their way. Or the distractions of a court battle and its costs may become overwhelming.

**[I’m asking you to STAND UP FOR ME, so I can keep working](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmo38775nchpn35burceocoesai1ts9bksl68b8o_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie4ob6c3h2bs)**. And I’ll commit to you that **I will NOT let you down**.

So please, **[make a donation to my legal defense fund through Liberty Guard](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zatdoslugkcd4lbnlarc3dvqqtlgc2c7e1ith2io_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie4ob6c3h2bs)**. We have a long way to do to hit our goal, so please, donate as much as you can.

Thank you for your direct or indirect support over the years. Your views, donations or simply talking about my work to friends and family has kept me going for 14 years . . . **and we cannot stop now!**

Respectfully,

James O’Keefe

P.S. I have 20 days to file my response to the lawsuit. I have to raise enough money to pay for a retainer and cover the legal work to defend against this lawsuit. This is unfortunately urgent so please, **[donate today](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zm867eg86lnf5gah1s6kkmdmcta2622d99qaq9hg_rp22sh2s8i66o77c3ie4ob6c3h2bs)**.

---

A fresh start, being forced to start over, I’ll admit is thrilling. And I’m starting armed with all of the lessons I’ve learned to avoid the pitfalls I’ve experienced. Me and my teams are more efficient, we’re more productive, and our work hits like a sledgehammer. But my work will be silenced if my former employer gets their way. Or the distractions of a court battle and its costs may become overwhelming. . And I’ll commit to you that I will NOT let you down. So please, . We have a long way to do to hit our goal, so please, donate as much as you can. Thank you for your direct or indirect support over the years. Your views, donations or simply talking about my work to friends and family has kept me going for 14 years . . . and we cannot stop now! Respectfully, James O’Keefe P.S. I have 20 days to file my response to the lawsuit. I have to raise enough money to pay for a retainer and cover the legal work to defend against this lawsuit. This is unfortunately urgent so please, . GOP Presidential 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 |

body:

Worse yet, both teens took places at the podium over women but **FAILED** to show up for the preliminary finals.

I am absolutely disgusted. _**How long will we let the transgender mob destroy the rights women worked so hard for?**_

I am teaming up with Marsha Blackburn to SAVE women's sports, but Joe Biden and the Democrats are determined to shut us down and silence us.

Well, if you know one thing about me - there is no world where I will let that happen.

name: John Fetterman
subject: Sara Innamorato 🫶🏼
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
We need Sara Innamorato as our next Allegheny County Executive.
#
Hey Derek, it's John.
**Today I am proud to announce my *official* endorsement of Sara Innamorato for Allegheny County Executive.** Allegheny County is my home, it's where I chose to raise a family, and I know that our neighbors deserve a collaborative and passionate leader like Sara as our next Executive.
But, before I go any further, I need to ask:
**[Can I count on you to show up for Sara by chipping in $5 or whatever you can today? Republicans have said they’re planning to spend $2 million on this race and we need to ensure Sara has the resources to win in November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_june?refcode=Fetterman-8428&refcode2=8428_434096_ugduU-&akid=8428%2E434096%2EugduU-)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_june?amount=5&refcode=em20230627-8428&refcode2=8428_434096_ugduU-&akid=8428%2E434096%2EugduU-)**
**Sara Innamorato would be the first woman to serve as Allegheny County Executive.** She first ran for State Representative in 2018 because Pennsylvania ranked 49th out of 50 in terms of women's representation in the state legislature. Since then she has continued to encourage more and more women to run for office and get involved in politics.
**Sara Innamorato has always fought for all of us.** She was the House sponsor of the Whole Home Repairs program and key to making sure that we unlocked $125 million to keep seniors and working people in their homes. This program was so successful, I’m fighting to bring it to the federal level.
I served as Mayor in Braddock for four terms, and I know Sara has the tools to be a successful executive and bring people together from all around this county. It’s an honor to stand with Sara in this campaign, and I am proud to support her.
**[If you stand with us, please chip in $5 or anything you are able to help Sara. We need to do everything we can to ensure that Sara Innamorato can win against her opponent and continue delivering real progress for Allegheny County. Please chip in today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_june?refcode=Fetterman-8428&refcode2=8428_434096_ugduU-&akid=8428%2E434096%2EugduU-)**
Thank you,
John 💛
P.S. Can’t make a donation, but still want to support Sara? Sign up to get involved however you can by clicking [**here**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49705?t=1&akid=8428%2E434096%2EugduU-).

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20230627-8428-footer&t=2&refcode2=8428_434096_ugduU-&akid=8428%2E434096%2EugduU-)**

body:

Hey there,
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to split a small donation between Seth Moulton and our campaign ahead of our FEC deadline [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff] . But first, I wanted to explain why your gift is so important — especially right now.
From the moment I jumped into the race, Republicans piled on.
It actually started the night right before I announced my campaign. In one of Kevin McCarthy’s first acts as Speaker, he unilaterally removed me from serving on the House Intelligence Committee.
Then it was Matt Gaetz. He introduced legislation trying to bar me from accessing classified information.
Then came Tucker Carlson. He recently launched into a desperate rant about me on his primetime Fox News show.
Then Donald Trump piled on too. He couldn’t resist. He dedicated part of his CPAC speech to hurl insult after insult against me.
And I’m going to be honest, I don’t even send you the really crazy stuff.
It’s just the beginning. After every one of their attacks, I then receive thousands more like it online from their MAGA loyalists trying to sabotage our work to defend democracy.
Republicans see me as their boogeyman this election. Why? Because I’ve stood up to these bullies and called out their lies.
It’s clear they don’t want me in the Senate. They don’t want oversight. They don’t want me to hold them accountable. They don’t want an outspoken defender of democracy on the Senate floor.
Bad news for Republicans: I’ve never been one to give up a fight — especially when it gets tough. I’m not going to let Donald Trump or any one of his lackeys tear our campaign down.
Friend, I need to know you have my back the entire way. Will you pitch in a donation of $3 or more to Seth Moulton and our campaign before our FEC deadline? The attacks are only going to get nastier from here, so we need to prepare for everything they’re going to launch our way: [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Thank you for your support,
— Adam

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

Our end-of-quarter deadline is our first chance to publicly show our opponents that we are a force to be reckoned with. It’s our first chance to make a splash, and once Friday rolls around, we don’t get another chance at this. Your investment in this race will go far in our fight to spread my conservative message to every corner of North Carolina, and the country. It’s truly a team effort and we can’t win without you. For freedom, Mark Walker | Meet Mark Walker Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan. In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game. Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. * * *
**BREAKING NEWS
The United States Supreme Court has issued its decision in _Moore v. Harper_.**
* * *
The U.S. Supreme Court has just issued a historic decision to uphold our democratic system of checks and balances in _Moore v. ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
It’s hard to believe, but we’re already approaching the next FEC deadline—it’s this Friday, June 30.
Like other campaigns, we set goals and fundraising benchmarks throughout the election cycle to make sure we have the resources to run a strong campaign from now through the primary in March and general election in November—which is especially critical with three people entering the race to challenge Lizzie in the primary.
You’ve heard me say it before, but I’ll emphasize this point again: These quarterly deadlines are particularly important. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230627?refcode=folf230627]
Each quarter, we are required to file a finance report with the Federal Election Commission. The numbers on our report—the total number of dollars and the number of donors—demonstrate the strength of our campaign.
Of course, we want a strong report—especially going into the second half of the year—because a good report reflects not only on the strength of our campaign but our efforts to turn out the vote in Texas and take back the House in Washington. Both are absolutely critical in 2024.
I’m so grateful there are so many dedicated members of #TeamLizzie who generously and consistently respond to these deadlines. If you’re able to contribute before Friday’s deadline, it’d really help us end the quarter in a strong place. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230627?refcode=folf230627]
Thank you for your support!
Gordon Center

Dear Friend,
---
The Let Us Worship movement was a response to the authoritarian Covid lockdowns. We saw believers desperate to praise and worship, so we planted the flag and rejected the government's hypocrisy. What started as 300 Believers gathering on the Golden Gate Bridge soon turned into a nationwide revival.

In the last three years, we've seen God move in an astonishing way. We've held over 200 Let Us Worship events, with over 1 million in-person and online. Thousands have given their life to Jesus and been baptized in every corner of our nation, and across the globe!

On Sunday night, we celebrated all God has done in the last three years. It was a powerful time of praise, prayer, and testimony. If you weren't able to attend or watch live, you can watch the recap video below!

body:
We can’t fall short ahead of this Friday’s critical quarterly deadline.
#

Friends -
When it comes to ending gun violence in our communities, the fight never stops.
That’s because every day, innocent people in our nation are victims of preventable gun violence. While we see many tragedies unfold in the news, most victims’ stories don’t make the headlines.
At GIFFORDS, we work day in and day out to save lives. We research violence prevention solutions, we work to pass gun safety legislation, and we help elect leaders at every level of government who will have the courage to act.
That work is powered by the contributions made to GIFFORDS PAC from supporters just like you all over the country donating to emails just like this.
This Friday, we’ll be facing our June quarterly fundraising deadline. And I’ll be honest with you, right now we are pacing behind where we thought we’d be.
The goals we set are not arbitrary. We set them because we know that in order to stand up to the gun lobby’s large sums of money, we have to reach certain thresholds in order to compete.
We can’t fall short ahead of this critical quarterly deadline. That’s why I’m personally asking for your support today.

| | Peter, My amazing team does a great job of keeping track of some of the frequent questions folks have for me. So over the weekend, I took an hour to think about some of my answers. Read on – I’ve listed a few of the top questions here, and shared my responses! **[(If you’re in a hurry but still want to chip in to my campaign for U.S. Senate before our FIRST End-of-Quarter deadline, you can make a quick contribution here!)](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/3064?t=11&amount=25&akid=189%2E52803%2EfziFyr)** | | | [Donate](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/3064?t=12&amount=25&akid=189%2E52803%2EfziFyr)
---
**As County Executive, are you qualified to be Maryland’s next Senator?**
It’s true that local leadership requires a different lens than in Washington. But I think working at the community level on day-to-day issues like growing jobs, education, public safety, budgeting, and resource management taught me valuable lessons about leadership and communication – lessons that will guide me in the Senate.
I learned that the most successful policies are rooted in mutual trust, community cooperation, and common-sense thinking. If you ask me, we could use a lot more of that sort of thinking in the Senate.
**If elected to the Senate, what issues do you plan to address?**
An excellent question.
Needless to say, there’s a lot that needs doing. But I want to highlight two issues that are top-of-mind: gun violence and reproductive rights.
Our country has suffered more than 300 mass shootings this year, and it’s time our elected officials used the tools at their disposal to finally pass common sense gun laws that protect Americans.
It’s been more than a year since SCOTUS struck down Roe, and tens of millions of Americans are in states with abortion restrictions or outright bans. I’ll never stop fighting for reproductive freedom, and if we elect a pro-choice majority to the Senate willing to get rid of the filibuster, we can finally protect access to safe and legal abortion.
**What impact can my $10 or $25 really have in a race this big?**
Your contribution will have a HUGE impact, and here’s why.
My primary opponent is a multi-millionaire, so while he can skip the fundraising part of campaigning, we’re relying on a grassroots movement of thousands to help us compete.
When you donate, you’re helping our campaign knock on doors and make phone calls to the voters we need to reach in order to win. You’re helping us plan events and travel to every corner of Maryland to reach people where they’re at. And you’re helping us run ads and buy airtime so we can spread our Maryland-first message far and wide.
**It’s important for me to engage with supporters like you, Peter, because you’re a vital part of this team, and I want this campaign to reflect your values.**

Read on – I’ve listed a few of the top questions here, and shared my responses! | | | As County Executive, are you qualified to be Maryland’s next Senator? It’s true that local leadership requires a different lens than in Washington. But I think working at the community level on day-to-day issues like growing jobs, education, public safety, budgeting, and resource management taught me valuable lessons about leadership and communication – lessons that will guide me in the Senate. I learned that the most successful policies are rooted in mutual trust, community cooperation, and common-sense thinking. If you ask me, we could use a lot more of that sort of thinking in the Senate. If elected to the Senate, what issues do you plan to address? An excellent question. Needless to say, there’s a lot that needs doing. But I want to highlight two issues that are top-of-mind: gun violence and reproductive rights. Our country has suffered more than 300 mass shootings this year, and it’s time our elected officials used the tools at their disposal to finally pass common sense gun laws that protect Americans. It’s been more than a year since SCOTUS struck down Roe, and tens of millions of Americans are in states with abortion restrictions or outright bans. I’ll never stop fighting for reproductive freedom, and if we elect a pro-choice majority to the Senate willing to get rid of the filibuster, we can finally protect access to safe and legal abortion. name: Vivek Ramaswamy
subject: What Don Lemon is saying about me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vivek 2024
body:
|
Patriot,

A few months ago, Don Lemon tried to shut me up on air when I educated him on the 2nd amendment.

Just in case you missed it, this is what he said to me during a heated debate:

| **" When you have black skin and you live in this country, then you can disagree with me." **
---

**I dismantled his argument with facts _and that exchange catalyzed his firing from CNN._**

Now he's aggrieved and called me a **" liar, bigot, and insurrectionist."**

Moral of the story: now that the R-word ("Racist") has entirely lost its meaning, they'll just call you an insurrectionist instead.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62881920:J0IOelIKN:m:1:3299561967:13749B9D33C12FD3FA2C49403D585930:r)
Don Lemon simply cannot let it go.

He goes further and says "platforming"people like me is "a dereliction of journalistic duty."

In order to continue my campaign and fight for the values and principles that set this country into motion, **[I need your support. I can't do it alone. I need your help to continue spreading my message of freedom and progress.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62881920:J0IOelIKN:m:1:3299561967:13749B9D33C12FD3FA2C49403D585930:r)**

I am not afraid to bring the debate to anyone who is willing to talk about the important issues, but I won't back down.

I believe that we need to have honest, open discussions about the issues that matter most to Americans. _That's why I am running for office._

**[I hope you'll stand with me as I continue to call out Don Lemon and the mainstream media for their unfounded bias against conservatives.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62881920:J0IOelIKN:m:1:3299561967:13749B9D33C12FD3FA2C49403D585930:r)**

Thanks,

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62881920:J0IOelIKN:m:1:3299561967:13749B9D33C12FD3FA2C49403D585930:r)
Vivek Ramaswamy

[** STAND UP TO THE MAINSTREAM MEDIA ->**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62881920:J0IOelIKN:m:1:3299561967:13749B9D33C12FD3FA2C49403D585930:r)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[ ** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/62881920:J0IOelIKN:m:1:3299561967:13749B9D33C12FD3FA2C49403D585930:r)

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy - I'm a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot.

I'll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I'm answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will step-up and serve our GREAT nation. **My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career.**

[**chip in any amount
Send a Navy SEAL to the Senate**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=728366ae84b64adf89df3c06b655536f&_e=fuzqH0EyUS5AL2IEAcWp4J2sVBj-rwuJpWDvSkEQ0OItNIbTWEWr_fGR0ht3_oBvC4nyygvYuLFM2oyFAl8dqgok-jJcK90pXrvJGY5LmBR-Kd60dueV8kJjtESVNk3Mq8na3XWAeQTzUA26M_EXoOvQhqXmwAK3WnzzMkdw9QxybY4XyR-FlduK-Y75ZovVpg2QZYQWqnmnuZsTR4pj_PlUBufmsfqGGjqnW_h9WHL3wARKWm6TqSTSxaAS12tyiOahsBu5xkYLJiJXTX-A070PJUGbMmMivnZaTWKviYgYziASkfPwsVj6h_zmeQXkJrjnUeqWwxdTh1Wd0LK583XRSjGtBy45WFYhchaFIhD1PgLOXQa5UxPtQklUilzOeUOkM23XRRwi69tvLzaQxg%3D%3D)
You don't know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I've fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm.

Career politicians like Democrat Jon Tester, **who has been in elected office for nearly 25 years** , are not getting the job done. **[That's why I'm challenging him for his seat in the United States Senate.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=728366ae84b64adf89df3c06b655536f&_e=fuzqH0EyUS5AL2IEAcWp4J2sVBj-rwuJpWDvSkEQ0OItNIbTWEWr_fGR0ht3_oBvC4nyygvYuLFM2oyFAl8dqgok-jJcK90pXrvJGY5LmBR-Kd60dueV8kJjtESVNk3Mq8na3XWAeQTzUA26M_EXoOvQhqXmwAK3WnzzMkdw9QxybY4XyR-FlduK-Y75ZovVpg2QZYQWqnmnuZsTR4pj_PlUBufmsfqGGjqnW_h9WHL3wARKWm6TqSTSxaAS12ty0ik-6mGLu1iwgziLvKGppuKTg8eeieR52OrQ_C042-OMK1m97fGnNec4m7yHGL0jCtE0Z2jk0bFmvCZCDuLGO4l5BIMrw4eEBnYdgzTOipGyt7QzjxXe_1TBxTXysiLeXAcO2N7Ij6XNra9B6D6SCQ%3D%3D) **

**As a Navy SEAL, I fought and bled for this country – _and considering our crippling debt, open borders, and woke culture_ ** [**I'm prepared to sacrifice even more of myself for the betterment of all Americans.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=728366ae84b64adf89df3c06b655536f&_e=fuzqH0EyUS5AL2IEAcWp4J2sVBj-rwuJpWDvSkEQ0OItNIbTWEWr_fGR0ht3_oBvC4nyygvYuLFM2oyFAl8dqgok-jJcK90pXrvJGY5LmBR-Kd60dueV8kJjtESVNk3Mq8na3XWAeQTzUA26M_EXoOvQhqXmwAK3WnzzMkdw9QxybY4XyR-FlduK-Y75ZovVpg2QZYQWqnmnuZsTR4pj_PlUBufmsfqGGjqnW_h9WHL3wARKWm6TqSTSxaAS12tyIHeIOq7TWoo8-jVJ6-a4sQlD20rWoCWYhVMNCiOLX36FMWZBQ0IKzAi-ZISzwLhpaiC3zIe6NMA0a6GWiJQhGBRB-iO_TvFkpgHka55JOe4CvJKJRMVH0n8uv7ZcA4ZiUD7rvmuIoICuIEo46bdpTA%3D%3D)

We need strong leaders who will solve problems and put Montana - and America - FIRST.

When I joined the Navy, I made a commitment not only to myself, but to my country. Our country. Those of you reading this today who served in the Armed Forces will know that the commitment we made to America when we joined up isn't just for four, six, or even 20 years - it's lifelong.

[**My mission continues in a different way now, and I'm asking you to support me not only with your prayers, but with your financial backing, too.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=728366ae84b64adf89df3c06b655536f&_e=fuzqH0EyUS5AL2IEAcWp4J2sVBj-rwuJpWDvSkEQ0OItNIbTWEWr_fGR0ht3_oBvC4nyygvYuLFM2oyFAl8dqgok-jJcK90pXrvJGY5LmBR-Kd60dueV8kJjtESVNk3Mq8na3XWAeQTzUA26M_EXoOvQhqXmwAK3WnzzMkdw9QxybY4XyR-FlduK-Y75ZovVpg2QZYQWqnmnuZsTR4pj_PlUBufmsfqGGjqnW_h9WHL3wARKWm6TqSTSxaAS12tyFFDgmztIaIuzd3iDhnqTwLlJZS-5RYi7xYAdShFzMLtkrnlNVjSDnh9k7v2WYlZxrvgqeyJdIU7JAtIRO8nhs2Yw3YeqyI-4m_x6xfrqEMFenKDD70AU7_816ME2me_e6BCCysAQmAnFgufxmkukhw%3D%3D)

[**SEND IN THE SEAL
CHIP IN TODAY**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=728366ae84b64adf89df3c06b655536f&_e=fuzqH0EyUS5AL2IEAcWp4J2sVBj-rwuJpWDvSkEQ0OItNIbTWEWr_fGR0ht3_oBvC4nyygvYuLFM2oyFAl8dqgok-jJcK90pXrvJGY5LmBR-Kd60dueV8kJjtESVNk3Mq8na3XWAeQTzUA26M_EXoOvQhqXmwAK3WnzzMkdw9QxybY4XyR-FlduK-Y75ZovVpg2QZYQWqnmnuZsTR4pj_PlUBufmsfqGGjqnW_h9WHL3wARKWm6TqSTSxaAS12tySRVtXQkS-3ozYjyTwD3ZaMlGnVZ34eGcS0jm2Mb37KtUI9y3pUGJ_K-R-sXaHkvtAsGJq98m43XHY63z1rWVgZ0a47MBpZG1oBBYWzYdZGHKeSS5fiwygxtGX7QfjKqnklYA5cxItj8ViEmgpAtILQ%3D%3D)
During my time as a Navy SEAL, I was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific – I've been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces.

But, running to be Montana's next U.S. Senator will be the toughest mission yet.

**Just look at where we are as a nation.** Since Joe Biden took office our once strong economy is no longer what it once was as we experience skyrocketing inflation, our borders are more porous than ever before, and the woke culture of the Left is tearing apart the very fabric of our society.

_**I cannot - and will not - remain quiet when I know I can be of service to you and your family in the U.S. Senate.**_

[**I've been training for this moment my entire life, Fellow Conservative.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=728366ae84b64adf89df3c06b655536f&_e=fuzqH0EyUS5AL2IEAcWp4J2sVBj-rwuJpWDvSkEQ0OItNIbTWEWr_fGR0ht3_oBvC4nyygvYuLFM2oyFAl8dqgok-jJcK90pXrvJGY5LmBR-Kd60dueV8kJjtESVNk3Mq8na3XWAeQTzUA26M_EXoOvQhqXmwAK3WnzzMkdw9QxybY4XyR-FlduK-Y75ZovVpg2QZYQWqnmnuZsTR4pj_PlUBufmsfqGGjqnW_h9WHL3wARKWm6TqSTSxaAS12tyG4934sCJfWLPq6ZaEmoALlTGoXWrsTDDf-n9bRHv5pcb7NETf6iHrd7BKQ8-HfB-DBMvx9lzBTnzNuXkBiSUE8ScrccCPnhGBWla3Mq7_d2CLP0GafbteJs_qnsaeeOrIoqChT8JpiSg1Ip_QTDiwA%3D%3D)

To accomplish this mission, it's going to take all of America working together as a TEAM. Our adversary is well-armed and has well insulated himself against attacks over his three-term career in D.C. That's why I'm going to be counting on having the best possible team around me to successfully navigate the terrain. [**Are you up for the task?**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=728366ae84b64adf89df3c06b655536f&_e=fuzqH0EyUS5AL2IEAcWp4J2sVBj-rwuJpWDvSkEQ0OItNIbTWEWr_fGR0ht3_oBvC4nyygvYuLFM2oyFAl8dqgok-jJcK90pXrvJGY5LmBR-Kd60dueV8kJjtESVNk3Mq8na3XWAeQTzUA26M_EXoOvQhqXmwAK3WnzzMkdw9QxybY4XyR-FlduK-Y75ZovVpg2QZYQWqnmnuZsTR4pj_PlUBufmsfqGGjqnW_h9WHL3wARKWm6TqSTSxaAS12tyiuPRWtWS_saagc8GBs1Wwi1dV2CCWvGo8E4DawQQy0WiNJizLRFkkMpqohTgNapkqzrmSLnYTefvDM8eh2JLHLdg979DmyaFZBkxh4jlLKBFHF5-xaVu5B58Qk05KsGrZ_EBprL3RCpb87FRvtmVSg%3D%3D)

[**SEND IN THE SEAL

**June 30 is a critical moment for our campaign.** All eyes will be on Greg and our campaign when our FEC report is published, and we need to present our campaign in the strongest light possible.

As you know, the GOP is targeting OH-01 as a potential pick-up opportunity as they seek to keep and expand their House Majority. But with you on our team, I know we’re ready to fight back _and win._

[**We’re still short of our end-of-quarter fundraising goal - will you make a donation to our campaign before Friday night? subject: Can I get your thoughts on religious liberty in America?
body:
After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|

| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2df57525ec04dfc84fd33fcce8ed3d6&_e=yESVvoq0wgu1kJfwYWiaMyVPGBJMwVXL1xIxXuQPXlMJiFJseZ-3pey8uBOLJKrBvYyPHyl_XsgbPXvtlsOo5PYAlUpsKyoAWDiTB39pC8azpS59CcYiQ_9oxosgN8DMyIAmT_j5e1O3ZlT3uq39Z8C1Wn__1Xd9VaKWtq9MLK_GWo4HqfhZDob5eajEd67yvqPDTmNRW395GBQ5cf1UBf69RW633I19dZsEUCHT0JwVmWEFEUP0UmXgqLccCoZNyKx8ZOLeewlkXwHSnn9CfMQ1vYQS6X9K8-ncCBVNEBT76t3R1ruIPWpLoMCxkNazjqs_v3sC4L7rkYEfydccUYi4LzVS2hsH1I-G-E2l5xKUI5frrvect-4W2YclW9EKaJUWamwrhSA7FJo6MK2Evzuv5Do5Tmqi8nW6rtEmC6o%3D)

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2df57525ec04dfc84fd33fcce8ed3d6&_e=yESVvoq0wgu1kJfwYWiaMyVPGBJMwVXL1xIxXuQPXlMJiFJseZ-3pey8uBOLJKrBvYyPHyl_XsgbPXvtlsOo5PYAlUpsKyoAWDiTB39pC8azpS59CcYiQ_9oxosgN8DMyIAmT_j5e1O3ZlT3uq39Z8C1Wn__1Xd9VaKWtq9MLK_GWo4HqfhZDob5eajEd67yvqPDTmNRW395GBQ5cf1UBf69RW633I19dZsEUCHT0JwVmWEFEUP0UmXgqLccCoZNyKx8ZOLeewlkXwHSnn9CfAhKTMx_RHKvjoA-RORaQ5-cYO6oYFlq4mfjAf8QL7YML2Mr6G6M5jVD-HCUehIeEv_zELpJhEaP1nvG7Ez7RinMnOG7xCFEiMjYK1dIKxdt6K58sRan144pohvHAmA9YCrg90cMXJ9pojpuLMN1O_A%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2df57525ec04dfc84fd33fcce8ed3d6&_e=yESVvoq0wgu1kJfwYWiaMyVPGBJMwVXL1xIxXuQPXlMJiFJseZ-3pey8uBOLJKrBvYyPHyl_XsgbPXvtlsOo5PYAlUpsKyoAWDiTB39pC8azpS59CcYiQ_9oxosgN8DMyIAmT_j5e1O3ZlT3uq39Z8C1Wn__1Xd9VaKWtq9MLK_GWo4HqfhZDob5eajEd67yvqPDTmNRW395GBQ5cf1UBf69RW633I19dZsEUCHT0JwVmWEFEUP0UmXgqLccCoZNyKx8ZOLeewlkXwHSnn9CfEFaH7LH57W3rMnI2ORmGqXP281yRkqd0ZAJsuL-NxkvYhY_3-tixRIiXEPrWrXXDQjjosZO71lffb_YRI4-S-knDI-YH1Saruoc80q60fEGh90qMFDVV29cE0h-pncfEYBagais_yuzBCfmDw5_3-4%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e2df57525ec04dfc84fd33fcce8ed3d6&_e=yESVvoq0wgu1kJfwYWiaMyVPGBJMwVXL1xIxXuQPXlMJiFJseZ-3pey8uBOLJKrBvYyPHyl_XsgbPXvtlsOo5PYAlUpsKyoAWDiTB39pC8azpS59CcYiQ_9oxosgN8DMyIAmT_j5e1O3ZlT3uq39Z8C1Wn__1Xd9VaKWtq9MLK_GWo4HqfhZDob5eajEd67yvqPDTmNRW395GBQ5cf1UBf69RW633I19dZsEUCHT0JwVmWEFEUP0UmXgqLccCoZNyKx8ZOLeewlkXwHSnn9CfG4qWLrIyDdoeKVwSOw3flut27iWlg9n3M1VgvBryHIBMB9-XXQNFWAPdOm6FFpCl3XwgV-YTWjMHlY6nBQsTkc5pbSx6hVdkj810gQJ1tQyKRFNn6By3HCDSli1yArXS-6b8TAE_eOLKgOyiy-RAmk%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Steve Daines for Montana
clean_body: It's time to elect a Republican Senator from Montana to replace Jon Tester. | | | Fellow American, Montana is a red state. That much is plain and simple. But I have some bad news, Fellow American. Right now - in a state where President Trump won by over 16 points - Montana is represented by a Democrat named Jon Tester. However, today, we are one step closer to FLIPPING this seat. Why? Because my friend, Tim Sheehy, has officially announced his candidacy for United States Senate. Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL, a devoted husband and father, and a job-creating entrepreneur. While Jon Tester has been spending years rubbing elbows with DC lobbyists, Tim has been creating jobs right here in Montana. He's dedicated his life to serving our nation both here stateside and abroad. He's the type of leader we need. And he's the only candidate that can defeat Jon Tester next November. Fellow American, will you take a moment to read this email from my friend, Tim? I want you to hear directly from him on why he's running for the United States Senate. I am counting on you to help Tim have a HUGE first day. We're counting on you! Steve From: Tim Sheehy Date: June 27, 2023 Subject: As a Navy SEAL, I fought and bled for this country Fellow Conservative, My name is Tim Sheehy - I'm a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot. I'll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I'm answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will step-up and serve our GREAT nation. My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career. You don't know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I've fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm. Career politicians like Democrat Jon Tester, who has been in elected office for nearly 25 years , are not getting the job done. As a Navy SEAL, I fought and bled for this country – and considering our crippling debt, open borders, and woke culture We need strong leaders who will solve problems and put Montana - and America - FIRST. When I joined the Navy, I made a commitment not only to myself, but to my country. Our country. Those of you reading this today who served in the Armed Forces will know that the commitment we made to America when we joined up isn't just for four, six, or even 20 years - it's lifelong. During my time as a Navy SEAL, I was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific – I've been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces. But, running to be Montana's next U.S. Senator will be the toughest mission yet. Just look at where we are as a nation. Since Joe Biden took office our once strong economy is no longer what it once was as we experience skyrocketing inflation, our borders are more porous than ever before, and the woke culture of the Left is tearing apart the very fabric of our society. I cannot - and will not - remain quiet when I know I can be of service to you and your family in the U.S. Senate. To accomplish this mission, it's going to take all of America working together as a TEAM. Our adversary is well-armed and has well insulated himself against attacks over his three-term career in D.C. That's why I'm going to be counting on having the best possible team around me to successfully navigate the terrain. I'm aware that this isn't going to be an easy race to win; you don't see people lining up to take on incumbents very often because truthfully, it isn't the easy thing to do. But as they say in the SEALS, "nobody remembers a loser or a quitter." I can tell you this right now: We need real, competent leadership to save our country and protect the American Dream for future generations. Montana can do better. America can do better. You deserve better. Our veterans, my friends that didn't make it home, fought for better. Hooyah, Tim Sheehy Former Navy SEAL Republican for U.S. Senate Steve Daines is a fifth-generation Montanan, life-long sportsman and father of four serving the people of Montana as their Senator. Steve is committed to always putting Montana first as he works to bring real change to Washington and fights for more jobs, less government and common sense solutions to get our country back on track. This year, all eyes will once again be on Kentucky. Our statewide
elections will not only shape the future for families in the commonwealth,
it will determine the future of democracy in our country. Together, we
have shown what is possible when regular people stand together, and our
work is far from finished.

I am asking you to keep standing, and join me in helping Kentucky
Democrats hold the line up and down the ballot in 2023. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18975?t=1001&akid=3328%2E346206%2E2TFa6n ]Will you help
us reach our $5,000 end of month goal with a $25 contribution? 100% of
your donation will go to these incredible candidates.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18975?t=1002&akid=3328%2E346206%2E2TFa6n ][IMG]

Here are some quick reasons why your help is so important:

* Kentucky has a historically powerful Democratic slate this year.
We must show strength by winning the Governor’s race and as many
down ballots as possible.
* Our down-ballot candidates are crucial. Attorney General
Candidate Pam Stevenson, Secretary of State candidate Buddy
Wheatley, Treasurer Candidate Michael Bowman, Auditor Candidate
Kim Reeder, and Commissioner of Ag candidate Sierra Enlow are
essential to our efforts to win now and in the future. They need
your support against the GOP's robust funding campaign so they
can buy door hangers, mailers, tv ads and more. (This bullet
point can be shortened if we do the pics as I mentioned above)
* We must ensure Governor Andy Beshear's re-election. Beshear is a
vital counterweight to the GOP-dominated state legislature. His
challenger, Daniel Cameron, represents extreme, hateful views
that hurt Kentucky and the down ballot will fuel more momentum
to beat him.
* The GOP is taking drastic measures. From attacking our most
vulnerable communities to tearing down public education and
healthcare, their agenda is horribly cruel and dangerous. We
must raise a standard against their brand of hate.

Our victories this year will set the stage for flipping the Kentucky
legislature, and stopping the anti-democratic assault on all of our
families.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18975?t=1003&akid=3328%2E346206%2E2TFa6n ]Please donate now to help us hit our $5,000 goal before the end of the
month.

Let’s get this done.

-Charles

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e3bb7e73b41c4133b1e933f3e720f2bf&_e=GZ26JeMMFsaNsgkau7_rspUM0dT3KuGAJPIFJXKKQUUW8N0pdENpXK-pG-ykvbfN7LqkufXZiGHr136etgMT4MMw7G71u6WvM7SxjJghK7O9vWB8Qe1Vwp72kTte5Pi3ZMmSUBgUU4bzrtLntN7YA8ROAJIpInMl1z6DpynRy44_pIS5SqcHzKSXTDDzFEHh21SQjjvSVah_WJPemAH4l2uNq1LCvD3OjscnsjyA6aYxpz7DeqDGZfrXUAUnAJ4rx-siJ9oQI6mgoN9K-C5doBzHkWliC_iSr0JxtwS3QFsveSH8d9Y-wGO7yqw7P6N428KnsOyAVj9wo8XAGTY6CuaGE4ojIbzb8zkK_Sqj6jZNOYCZxbcV5boWX1-bjz1UyzCxdr0IOFNOovDN-WIXGg3onzJuIELFOdR0y3VJKTs%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e3bb7e73b41c4133b1e933f3e720f2bf&_e=GZ26JeMMFsaNsgkau7_rspUM0dT3KuGAJPIFJXKKQUUW8N0pdENpXK-pG-ykvbfN7LqkufXZiGHr136etgMT4MMw7G71u6WvM7SxjJghK7O9vWB8Qe1Vwp72kTte5Pi3ZMmSUBgUU4bzrtLntN7YA8ROAJIpInMl1z6DpynRy44_pIS5SqcHzKSXTDDzFEHh21SQjjvSVah_WJPemAH4l2uNq1LCvD3OjscnsjyA6aYxpz7DeqDGZfrXUAUnAJ4rx-siJ9oQI6mgoN9K-C5doInxvVcCOVmovpAFRLhp8rsgy40BCUa-zgphpR6c3wjeueiEqE2G7ccjwyjbYL0itNgD5X6ijHB4sz8OssA1TbQwnBzgVh0Py42Xnyrobu4vwdiMgW94_kzIbaGZxhMp82E2Js1mrHiKCOnBQZ_GKz0%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e3bb7e73b41c4133b1e933f3e720f2bf&_e=GZ26JeMMFsaNsgkau7_rspUM0dT3KuGAJPIFJXKKQUUW8N0pdENpXK-pG-ykvbfN7LqkufXZiGHr136etgMT4MMw7G71u6WvM7SxjJghK7O9vWB8Qe1Vwp72kTte5Pi3ZMmSUBgUU4bzrtLntN7YA8ROAJIpInMl1z6DpynRy44_pIS5SqcHzKSXTDDzFEHh21SQjjvSVah_WJPemAH4l2uNq1LCvD3OjscnsjyA6aYxpz7DeqDGZfrXUAUnAJ4rx-siJ9oQI6mgoN9K-C5doM5SIVK65F8lNe9duT0SVDN3JaQPbE0H45KQVh4kUebwdqplJtO9wfFfk1lGQVKO2uMUfgFnBJzrzIKLpAP-tt0zb4Mm1rkpCL80yHyl59hwpoFEHK8T9HrM0RI5rCpJB8kj2Yxc8wiOpqzZYszNNNQ%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Dr. Ben Carson

body:

Dear Friend,

Fourteen years ago, I founded an organization from my parent's home with the intent of using undercover investigative journalism to expose the corrupt.

You've seen my work. Most Americans have.

In February, after releasing a historic investigation on Pfizer, the Board of Directors of the organization I created from scratch, ousted me.

It was a blow, but things happen for a reason. Today, I'm unleashed to do my work through my new organization, OMG, without any obstruction and **no one to stop me.**

Since I was fired, I've chosen not to look back. I want to move forward with my work, with happiness and spirit. **And I move forward carrying with me the many lessons I learned.**

Those 14 years were formative.

When I started, my hands would tremble when I confronted a target of my investigations. It took time, but I overcame my fears of confrontation by grounding myself in principle.

I learned about trust, loyalty, and leadership.

Most importantly, I learned the hard way the true depth of Michael Jordan's quote on leadership: "Winning has a price. **And leadership has a price**."

I've been sued for exposing the truth more times than I can count. And, get this, **yesterday, I was sued in federal court by the very organization I founded.**

name: Katie Porter
subject: Recent reporter question

body:
In a recent TV interview, I was asked if I had the fundraising power needed to run statewide here in California.
Derek,
Katie Porter here. In a recent TV interview, I was asked if I had the fundraising power needed to run statewide here in California.
People are wondering if our team has the strength to go the distance because last quarter we were outraised by _two million dollars._ It’s not because our opponent has thousands more supporters. We pulled in more money than any other candidate in small-dollar donations, but because of big checks and “max-out” contributions, he outraised us.
And because I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or Big Oil, Big Pharma, or Big Bank CEOs, some have said we don’t have a chance of catching up.
**Here’s the deal: I know that’s BS. I’m confident our grassroots team has what it takes to fuel this campaign and win. Can you help prove the strength of our movement and chip in $15 today?** Here’s a link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230627-1**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230627-1?refcode=EMAI27_1_PLA_20230627_V1_F&refcode2=25563_3422442_hEBY3f&akid=25563%2E3422442%2EhEBY3f)
One of my favorite campaign activities is calling our grassroots supporters at random and saying thank you—getting to hear from the baristas and teachers and electricians who power our campaign, giving what they can, when they can.
Our campaign’s fundraising is operating in a way that might be unique, and that’s because I’m not just another career politician in Washington. I’m a single mom who ran for office when Trump came to power—and I’m here to shake up the status quo, hold corporations accountable, and deliver for working people.
**Our end of quarter deadline is this Friday, and everyone's watching to see if we’ll be outraised once again.** This week is incredibly consequential for our campaign. I’d be so appreciative if you could make a contribution [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230627-1**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230627-1?refcode=EMAI27_1_PLA_20230627_V1_F&refcode2=25563_3422442_hEBY3f&akid=25563%2E3422442%2EhEBY3f)
Thanks so much,
Katie

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. This year, Governor DeSantis signed: Record tax relief ESG prohibitions Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

name: Chrissy Houlahan
subject: proud to be a science nerd
body:
| | |
---
Derek, you may not know this, but before I was a representative in the House, I was an engineer.

Some might say that jumping from a career in science and technology to one in politics might seem odd. But my years using my STEM education and in public service have taught me that the two realms have a lot in common. Looking to the data, rejecting misinformation, questioning one’s own biases – these are part of a STEM professional’s toolkit and should be part of a politician’s, too.
****But right now, for too many of my colleagues in Congress, science and truth seem to take a back seat to ideology. I’m committed to defending the principles of inquiry and truth in the House, but I can only continue to do so with your support – which is why I’m reaching out ahead of my end-of-quarter deadline.[ Please, Derek, will you make a gift of $5 to ensure I can fight for evidence-based change?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65507437/413667236/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk838-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDE2MWUzMy0xZTE1LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5Wm7uDA8f69z6G2gARxcsX663IvBl5jXj_EzzmQW0LA=)**[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65507438/413667237/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk838-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDE2MWUzMy0xZTE1LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5Wm7uDA8f69z6G2gARxcsX663IvBl5jXj_EzzmQW0LA=)**
I can already see that I’ve used my background to pass legislation that helps Americans. Last year, I helped pass the Inflation Reduction Act, which makes historic investments in clean energy and is expected to reduce emissions by approximately 40% by 2030 – and I helped pass the CHIPS Act, which made our supply chains more resilient and helped us to outcompete China.
I’ve also spearheaded the Women in STEM and Bipartisan Climate Solutions caucuses to foster exchange and productive policymaking. In this age of misinformation, it seems like everything is being put up to dispute for political reasons – from climate science to COVID-19, election legitimacy to economic policy. **I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished so far, but to face these troubling trends, we need more solution-oriented, logic and data-based approaches to passing legislation that will help American families.**
**I’d like to think I’ve been doing this so far.** But I can only continue to do so with the support of this grassroots team. **The 2024 elections are closer than they seem, and now’s the best time for us to gather our resources to ensure we can continue to spread our message of truth, justice, and progress.[Please, Derek, can I count on your support ahead of my end-of-quarter deadline? Every dollar you donate will go so far.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65507439/413667238/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk838-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDE2MWUzMy0xZTE1LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5Wm7uDA8f69z6G2gARxcsX663IvBl5jXj_EzzmQW0LA=)**

_**Begin Forwarded Message:**_
Peter,

June ends this Friday at midnight and I need your help.

When the month ends, we’re required to report all of our fundraising progress from the last three months to the Federal Election Commission (FEC) and it’s a crucial test of campaign strength.
