Incredible, but true! With just $30,000, our campaign managed to secure a whopping 111,000 votes in 2022. 40% of the vote with limited resources and financial support. Imagine the possibilities when we have even more resources at our disposal. Today, we invite you to join us in making a real difference as we take this movement to new heights.
Our journey started with limited funds, but what we lacked in financial muscle, we made up for in determination and grassroots support. Through tireless efforts and the unwavering dedication of our team, we reached out to our community, inspiring people with our vision for a brighter future.
Now, with your help, we can achieve so much more. A modest investment of just $200 can create a wave of change that will reverberate throughout our district, our state, and beyond. Here's what we can do together:
| | | | | | | | | **Amplify Our Message:** With increased funds, we can broaden our reach and engage even more voters. By investing in strategic advertising campaigns, we will ensure that our message resonates with every household, highlighting our commitment to the values and issues that matter most to our community.
---
**Leverage Technology:** Embracing innovative tools and cutting-edge technologies will enable us to maximize our impact. With your support, we can invest in state-of-the-art digital platforms, data analytics, and communication tools, empowering us to connect with voters like never before. Together, we will harness the power of technology to build a stronger, more inclusive democracy.
| **Mobilize the Community:** Building upon the strong foundation we've established, we will enhance our grassroots efforts. Your contribution will help us organize town hall meetings, community events, and voter education programs. We believe in empowering our constituents and ensuring that their voices are heard loud and clear.
---
**Expand Our Team:** The strength of our campaign lies in our dedicated volunteers. By bolstering our team with experienced professionals, we can optimize our operations, improve outreach, and effectively manage the complex challenges of a competitive campaign. Your support will help us recruit talented individuals who share our passion and drive.

Your contribution, no matter the size, will make a tangible difference. We firmly believe that progress is not just about the numbers—it's about the unwavering dedication of individuals like you, who are committed to shaping a better future for all.
Join us as we continue to defy expectations, break down barriers, and make a lasting impact. Together, we can build a stronger, more vibrant community that leaves no voice unheard. Contribute today and be a part of the movement that turns dreams into reality.
Donate now and let's propel our campaign to victory!!

# Together We Can Make a Difference,
# Together We Will

Our campaign is rooted in the power of community – in individuals like you, who believe in our shared mission. Our strength lies in every hand raised to volunteer, every conversation started about our cause, and every donation that supports our endeavors.
Whether you have time to volunteer, the passion to spread our message, or the means to contribute financially, every effort counts. No action is too small, and every step taken brings us closer to the positive change we seek.
When we volunteer our time, we create connections. When we spread our message, we expand our reach. And when we contribute, we fuel our journey forward. These efforts are the heart of our campaign, and they echo the power of our shared resolve.
Remember, this campaign is about more than a seat in Congress. It's about the future we can build together for our district, our community, our home. With your support, together we can make a difference, and together, we will.

| Withdrawing from your retirement accounts in the right order could help save you years-worth of income in unnecessary taxes. The wrong order could potentially eat into your retirement nest egg. Work to maximize your savings with these [5 tips to withdraw wisely](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyUUbGu2zAM_Bp5syFLjhQPHooGXop0eEtHgZFYW4hkGxQD9_194ZfXFOjWkbg7Hu_44-quEFNcpu-Qcbh7clQcZQelINc3LFzvkedAsDslla6lqZV1ugpD6L0BU-HQmrPt5enU2moePKLupA36ZM9eyU72obMKz9beMPTGVHE49kijbNu33Uk2oeuMbnV_87LXQXeik5CQuLkjbn5dJsJSCLfHLUUPS-PXXKVhZt6K0F-EGoUagTj6hKUpGYg_jj94Qo3PCPBe8_pKItQYl4C_mplzEnp8cHZlfZBHoS8EcclwRxLKHEDGEB9Z6Mvn7CFvEKfloGZw7ick7_y6MC7sDrcd3v8aPSVPVOjLq0uK08xupYDktnUDz-AW5H2l-6eIkQ7Xf0AnjWyVDu7tWn_7-lb_6bKiIWx7TCkWY0UnpwwxfVTF__HV3wEAAP__seezFg). **1\. Start With Your Investment Income** Withdrawing from your investments first gives your retirement accounts more time to compound interest. If you dive straight into your 401(k) or IRA, you could cost yourself years worth of income in retirement savings. **2\. Don't Automatically Claim Social Security Benefits at 62** If you want your maximum Social Security benefits, you’ll need to work until your “full retirement” age. But benefits at age 62, 66 or 67 are not your maximum benefits. The maximum Social Security retirement benefit kicks in at age 70. If you claim before, you're not getting your full entitlement. **3\. Delay Withdrawing From Your 401(k) and IRA Until RMDs Kick In** You can start withdrawing money from your 401(k) when you turn 59 1/2, but that doesn't mean it's a good idea. The law doesn't require you to start taking Required Minimum Distributions until you turn 72, so this is time your money can keep growing with compound interest.

**4\. Don't Tap into Your Roth Before Exhausting Other Options** Put off withdrawing money from your Roth IRA as long as possible. You paid taxes up front so you can take money out of your Roth IRA and it won’t count as taxable income. Your Roth IRA also will continue to grow tax-free as you tap into your other accounts.

**5\. Speak with A Financial Advisor to Find the Best Way to Plan Withdrawals** Determining the optimal sequence to withdraw money from your retirement accounts is different for everyone, so we recommend [speaking with a financial advisor](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyUUbGu2zAM_Bp5syFLjhQPHooGXop0eEtHgZFYW4hkGxQD9_194ZfXFOjWkbg7Hu_44-quEFNcpu-Qcbh7clQcZQelINc3LFzvkedAsDslla6lqZV1ugpD6L0BU-HQmrPt5enU2moePKLupA36ZM9eyU72obMKz9beMPTGVHE49kijbNu33Uk2oeuMbnV_87LXQXeik5CQuLkjbn5dJsJSCLfHLUUPS-PXXKVhZt6K0F-EGoUagTj6hKUpGYg_jj94Qo3PCPBe8_pKItQYl4C_mplzEnp8cHZlfZBHoS8EcclwRxLKHEDGEB9Z6Mvn7CFvEKfloGZw7ick7_y6MC7sDrcd3v8aPSVPVOjLq0uK08xupYDktnUDz-AW5H2l-6eIkQ7Xf0AnjWyVDu7tWn_7-lb_6bKiIWx7TCkWY0UnpwwxfVTF__HV3wEAAP__seezFg). The wrong order could potentially eat into your retirement nest egg. Work to maximize your savings with these . 1\. Start With Your Investment Income Withdrawing from your investments first gives your retirement accounts more time to compound interest. If you dive straight into your 401(k) or IRA, you could cost yourself years worth of income in retirement savings. 2\. Don't Automatically Claim Social Security Benefits at 62 If you want your maximum Social Security benefits, you’ll need to work until your “full retirement” age. But benefits at age 62, 66 or 67 are not your maximum benefits. The maximum Social Security retirement benefit kicks in at age 70. If you claim before, you're not getting your full entitlement. 3\. Delay Withdrawing From Your 401(k) and IRA Until RMDs Kick In You can start withdrawing money from your 401(k) when you turn 59 1/2, but that doesn't mean it's a good idea. The law doesn't require you to start taking Required Minimum Distributions until you turn 72, so this is time your money can keep growing with compound interest. 4\. Don't Tap into Your Roth Before Exhausting Other Options Put off withdrawing money from your Roth IRA as long as possible. You paid taxes up front so you can take money out of your Roth IRA and it won’t count as taxable income. Your Roth IRA also will continue to grow tax-free as you tap into your other accounts. 5\. I'll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I'm answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will step-up and serve our GREAT nation. My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career. You don't know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I've fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm. Career politicians like Democrat Jon Tester, who has been in elected office for nearly 25 years , are not getting the job done. As a Navy SEAL, I fought and bled for this country – and considering our crippling debt, open borders, and woke culture We need strong leaders who will solve problems and put Montana - and America - FIRST. When I joined the Navy, I made a commitment not only to myself, but to my country. Our country. Those of you reading this today who served in the Armed Forces will know that the commitment we made to America when we joined up isn't just for four, six, or even 20 years - it's lifelong. During my time as a Navy SEAL, I was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific – I've been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces. But, running to be Montana's next U.S. Senator will be the toughest mission yet. Just look at where we are as a nation. Since Joe Biden took office our once strong economy is no longer what it once was as we experience skyrocketing inflation, our borders are more porous than ever before, and the woke culture of the Left is tearing apart the very fabric of our society. I cannot - and will not - remain quiet when I know I can be of service to you and your family in the U.S. Senate. To accomplish this mission, it's going to take all of America working together as a TEAM. Our adversary is well-armed and has well insulated himself against attacks over his three-term career in D.C. I'm aware that this isn't going to be an easy race to win; you don't see people lining up to take on incumbents very often because truthfully, it isn't the easy thing to do. But as they say in the SEALS, "nobody remembers a loser or a quitter." I can tell you this right now: We need real, competent leadership to save our country and protect the American Dream for future generations. Montana can do better. America can do better. You deserve better. Our veterans, my friends that didn't make it home, fought for better. body:

#
Hey Peter, it's Lauren — Pramila's Campaign Manager!
I wanted to check in with you personally today as we begin our end-of-quarter push to raise $35,000 before midnight on Friday. Now I know what you might be thinking, $35,000 is an ambitious goal — but don’t worry, we have a plan.
Our movement is entirely powered by grassroots support. That means we won’t take a dime of corporate money — ever. But that also means that we need to rely on the power of small-dollar donations from supporters like you to drive our movement.
**So, we did the math:**
In order to raise $35,000 before midnight on Friday, we need at least 10 supporters from 18326 to chip in at least $3. [**Can we count on you to be one of the supporters we need to chip in today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42609?refcode=em20230627-2648&t=1&akid=2648%2E420207%2Ea42BNR)
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42609?refcode=em20230627-2648&t=20&akid=2648%2E420207%2Ea42BNR)**
At the end of the quarter **our campaign's fundraising numbers will be consolidated and publicized for everyone to see.** That means GOP challengers will be looking to determine the strength, stability, and unity of our collective movement — _and search for pitfalls to swoop in and stop our momentum._
We need to work together to protect our hard-fought victories from the GOP majority that wants to reverse our progress and continue to target our communities.
No matter what, we will continue to fight for working people across the country — but we need the tools, resources, and support to sustain our movement. [**Please, chip in today to help us kick off our end of the quarter fundraising efforts and reach our goal before midnight on Friday.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42609?refcode=em20230627-2648&t=21&akid=2648%2E420207%2Ea42BNR)

name: Team Lucas
subject: Good news, bad news
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
#
We’ve got some good news and some bad news, Peter.
**We’ll start with the bad news:**
Our big end-of-quarter fundraising deadline is on Friday and we’re still about 2,000 donations away from meeting our goal.
This deadline is the next real chance for the insiders and pundits watching our race to evaluate the strength behind Lucas and our grassroots movement — and we need to prove that we’re ready to take on Josh Hawley and flip this Senate seat.
Falling short isn’t an option.
**But here’s the good news:**
Grassroots supporters like you have always shown up in moments like these.
Whether it’s by donating to an email like this one, sharing one of our ads, or even just telling your friends and family about our campaign — Lucas and our whole team have always been able to count on you.

Friends,
We all remember the tyranny that was forced upon us during the Covid-19 pandemic. State governors, both Democrat and Republican, shut down our businesses, closed our schools, and punished all who didn't comply.
The reason most governors were able to do this was because of state laws granting them "emergency powers" in a time of crisis that gave them a broad mandate to enforce Covid restrictions. They abused these powers, keeping them in place far longer than they were intended, and the results were disastrous with all the evidence showing how lockdowns did more harm than good.
Well, what if we told you that interest groups now want to make those "emergency powers" the standard in state law. The supposedly non-partisan Uniform Law Commission (ULC) has proposed model legislation for all 50 states that would do just that.
The ULC is an entity that has been around since 1892 and works to draft model legislation in order to provide clarity to areas of statutory law across jurisdictions. They have now decided that it's important to give every governor in America the ability to unilaterally declare emergency public health powers whenever they want with no ability to challenge them in court.
State Freedom Caucuses have already been fighting back against this abuse of power. Recently, the Arizona Freedom Caucus [passed](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b1ee0fc7-18a8-4366-b04b-1ef9ce6a44db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) HCR 2039, a ballot measure that will constitutionally terminate the Governor's emergency powers during a state of emergency after 30 days, should AZ voters approve it in the 2024 election.
All eleven Freedom Caucuses in our network have vowed in writing to fight against the model legislation from the ULC. We will always oppose further concentrations of power in the executive branch and will never allow politicians to legislate away your rights.
Read their full response to the ULC here.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ef8aae5d-50e7-49c0-ad79-bccdf2538460?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**South Carolina:**
The SCFC had a major victory in court this week that ensured CRT would be removed from the Lexington County School District. Last October, the SCFC obtained a five-minute undercover recording of Tarika Sullivan, a professional development specialist for EL Education which contracted with the district, talking about how they plan to get around state laws to teach CRT to children.
The SC Freedom Caucus wasted no time bringing them to court and a settlement was reached which requires the school district to terminate its contract with EL Education. The SCFC will always fight to keep divisive left-wing racial ideology out of the classroom.
Read the full story in [Fox News](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/31446f03-2eef-4986-bae5-e588ab8155f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**Pennsylvania:**
Responding to a written request by the PA Freedom Caucus, Penn State University's flagship hospital recently disclosed that they are prescribing puberty blockers and other gender change procedures to children as young as 5-years-old.
Our caucuses will never stand for that, which is why they successfully whipped their colleagues last week into denying Penn State the two-thirds majority needed to receive funding from the legislature, denying the university $259 million - not just for their hospital but for ALL their funding.
When hospitals are doing irreversible damage to our children, Freedom Caucuses will always fight to stop it.
Read the full story in the [Daily Signal](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bd2ee13f-dfa8-4726-8e35-15e7543051c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**Paid Subscriptions:**
Don't forget that you can now become a paying subscriber to the State Freedom Caucus Network on Substack. You'll be supporting our work and will get a behind the scenes look into what the Freedom Caucus is doing at the state and federal level.
Our first piece of paywalled content is [my interview](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6f51f744-a42a-49ae-9932-c1361f801db5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Virginia Republican and House Freedom Caucus member Rep. Bob Good.

Leftists Want To Normalize Covid Tyranny | | | Jun 27 | | | | | | Friends, We all remember the tyranny that was forced upon us during the Covid-19 pandemic. State governors, both Democrat and Republican, shut down our businesses, closed our schools, and punished all who didn't comply. The reason most governors were able to do this was because of state laws granting them "emergency powers" in a time of crisis that gave them a broad mandate to enforce Covid restrictions. They abused these powers, keeping them in place far longer than they were intended, and the results were disastrous with all the evidence showing how lockdowns did more harm than good. Well, what if we told you that interest groups now want to make those "emergency powers" the standard in state law. The supposedly non-partisan Uniform Law Commission (ULC) has proposed model legislation for all 50 states that would do just that. The ULC is an entity that has been around since 1892 and works to draft model legislation in order to provide clarity to areas of statutory law across jurisdictions. They have now decided that it's important to give every governor in America the ability to unilaterally declare emergency public health powers whenever they want with no ability to challenge them in court. State Freedom Caucuses have already been fighting back against this abuse of power. Recently, the Arizona Freedom Caucus HCR 2039, a ballot measure that will constitutionally terminate the Governor's emergency powers during a state of emergency after 30 days, should AZ voters approve it in the 2024 election. All eleven Freedom Caucuses in our network have vowed in writing to fight against the model legislation from the ULC. We will always oppose further concentrations of power in the executive branch and will never allow politicians to legislate away your rights. Read their full response to the ULC here. | | ---|---|--- South Carolina: The SCFC had a major victory in court this week that ensured CRT would be removed from the Lexington County School District. The SC Freedom Caucus wasted no time bringing them to court and a settlement was reached which requires the school district to terminate its contract with EL Education. The SCFC will always fight to keep divisive left-wing racial ideology out of the classroom. Read the full story in . Team,

I’m proud to announce that just last week, I introduced the Rebuild Rural America Act which addresses the specific challenges rural areas face, and increases opportunities for federal investments. By investing in economic development and rethinking how the federal government provides support to rural communities, this legislation ensures that vital funding and resources reach rural communities in need.

From limited access to health care and high-speed internet to aging infrastructure and a rapidly changing economy, rural communities in Central and Southern Illinois are facing an onslaught of generational challenges. I came to Congress to fight for investment and support for our smallest cities and towns to help them survive and thrive in the 21st century — and I’m proud to introduce bold legislation to do just that.

These past two weeks have given us a clear look at what the priorities of this Republican-led House majority truly are.

Their agenda is not about improving lives. Rather than effectively govern, they’re focused on attacking women’s rights, banning books, and making life _harder_ for working families in this country.

**Case in point: late last week, we learned that Rep. Mike Garcia approved a bill that would lead to a nationwide ban on a safe and widely used abortion medication, mifepristone.**

If elected, I’ll fight tirelessly to protect reproductive freedoms. I’ll also work across the aisle to find solutions to some of the most pressing issues facing CA-27 -- creating economic opportunities, protecting Social Security and Medicare, and addressing the wildfire crisis.

**CA-27 is the only Republican-held toss-up race in Southern California. What happens here could determine which party controls the House for the next two years. This is our chance to flip this seat and move our community forward, but I’ll need your support to do it:**

Peter, **Rep. Cori Bush is a fierce ally of the working class.** Cori knows what it's like to live paycheck to paycheck, to be uninsured, and to be burdened with student and medical debt. As a nurse, she’s advocated for patients who had to ration or skip medication because they couldn’t afford it. She’s seen patients die because our for-profit healthcare system prioritized profits over people’s lives. Together, we’ve introduced legislation to cap insulin at $20 per vial and to fund good-paying green jobs that will help us transition to renewable energy. She’s a proven leader pushing for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, reproductive justice, and more. [**When you stand up for working people, powerful special interests -- from Republican extremists to dark money Super PACs -- try to silence and stop you. That’s why Cori needs our support. clean_body: My friend Cori Bush has joined me in taking on billionaire fossil fuel and pharmaceutical executives. | | Peter, Rep. Cori Bush is a fierce ally of the working class. Cori knows what it's like to live paycheck to paycheck, to be uninsured, and to be burdened with student and medical debt. As a nurse, she’s advocated for patients who had to ration or skip medication because they couldn’t afford it. She’s seen patients die because our for-profit healthcare system prioritized profits over people’s lives. Together, we’ve introduced legislation to cap insulin at $20 per vial and to fund good-paying green jobs that will help us transition to renewable energy. She’s a proven leader pushing for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, reproductive justice, and more. In the wealthiest country in the history of the world, no one should die because they cannot afford the medication they need. But more than 30 million Americans still don’t have health insurance, and medical bills are the number one cause of bankruptcy in the United States. More than 1.3 million Americans were forced to ration insulin last year. Cori Bush and I know that healthcare is a human right. Our efforts in Congress, alongside grassroots pressure, have delivered victories for working class people. We successfully pressured insulin providers to lower costs, and pushed the President to use the Defense Production Act to invest in renewable energy. Even when our energy bill didn’t pass, Cori led efforts to secure funding for energy efficiency and renewable energy in other bills, tackling the climate crisis and lowering utility costs for working class families. Cori has accomplished more in her first two years in Congress than some members of Congress do in decades. As a grassroots activist, she also brings the people into Congress with her. That’s exactly what we need to build a government that works for all of us, not just those at the top. Because there is only one way we will transform this country: together. Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy - I'm a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot.

I'll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I'm answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will step-up and serve our GREAT nation. **My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career.**

[**chip in any amount
Send a Navy SEAL to the Senate**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=0cc97c60486b4cafb1332687188b1ca3&_e=ANe8ff3VXcCAPBDm83rJom9ivqkyvPylDuqBrLvFKoZ__4wZOcsYqA2PnUi69RUfzGbQAwNNR-edd8ZDkoorwhcjD-Ewik59R-kmgL5dog0iODO1zMLqKTJReFqQ4c62s-4RHX2i0sNH6vXzZoGM_xsssSSI8tkwsNb6Xls2XZiK3d-xGmKjVzIiahRtFEG7RHQOU3zRQ9Y74wiDJYI5yzcwTJYdd2vLD8vasQubH5gA8crZi2-Bn02-17Kh9qvfZJmm6OFOBSL4HzcFQsEbsIRojX0fep7v0ztlADFIdygqfwy-TIq2TnUc05o35tECQ9QW_umep3Vx-3341LHHNdQVHV-DT1mrLKDvuTCEy7hNynTCpplarnkGiMVfK5tNwob87X7ylSmK1W5-sHjpMQ%3D%3D)
You don't know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I've fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm.

Career politicians like Democrat Jon Tester, **who has been in elected office for nearly 25 years** , are not getting the job done. **[That's why I'm challenging him for his seat in the United States Senate.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=0cc97c60486b4cafb1332687188b1ca3&_e=ANe8ff3VXcCAPBDm83rJom9ivqkyvPylDuqBrLvFKoZ__4wZOcsYqA2PnUi69RUfzGbQAwNNR-edd8ZDkoorwhcjD-Ewik59R-kmgL5dog0iODO1zMLqKTJReFqQ4c62s-4RHX2i0sNH6vXzZoGM_xsssSSI8tkwsNb6Xls2XZiK3d-xGmKjVzIiahRtFEG7RHQOU3zRQ9Y74wiDJYI5yzcwTJYdd2vLD8vasQubH5gA8crZi2-Bn02-17Kh9qvfbbJSFHJcVFvjNF3EA7IykXhYACLmHtkX8biEbmOMG7gtjRkwmUM56Ks1Z96Egv1hLSj5BfGwHZ3z5YoufU1GG7Wdl1_0ZFl1xOZXgTaDLhk_sc_iRbzLBng4wtjnZRhlLuIWPXQQBVdoZ91IRPBPuA%3D%3D) **

**As a Navy SEAL, I fought and bled for this country – _and considering our crippling debt, open borders, and woke culture_ ** [**I'm prepared to sacrifice even more of myself for the betterment of all Americans.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=0cc97c60486b4cafb1332687188b1ca3&_e=ANe8ff3VXcCAPBDm83rJom9ivqkyvPylDuqBrLvFKoZ__4wZOcsYqA2PnUi69RUfzGbQAwNNR-edd8ZDkoorwhcjD-Ewik59R-kmgL5dog0iODO1zMLqKTJReFqQ4c62s-4RHX2i0sNH6vXzZoGM_xsssSSI8tkwsNb6Xls2XZiK3d-xGmKjVzIiahRtFEG7RHQOU3zRQ9Y74wiDJYI5yzcwTJYdd2vLD8vasQubH5gA8crZi2-Bn02-17Kh9qvfaQ8HUvS_XOohRkY5GVs6t72908x6zs0J59TWwbzFizdVfU1qq0b8sgDmTzcz_j0QXqTV1gLfeoYc1m3VZEVFa6GPiBiu0y-lYKWjwW5I4LyuopK4fulIWI2GgYMUcUoMFdJBbuQAlQQISjsx8tkD8g%3D%3D)

We need strong leaders who will solve problems and put Montana - and America - FIRST.

When I joined the Navy, I made a commitment not only to myself, but to my country. Our country. Those of you reading this today who served in the Armed Forces will know that the commitment we made to America when we joined up isn't just for four, six, or even 20 years - it's lifelong.

[**My mission continues in a different way now, and I'm asking you to support me not only with your prayers, but with your financial backing, too.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=0cc97c60486b4cafb1332687188b1ca3&_e=ANe8ff3VXcCAPBDm83rJom9ivqkyvPylDuqBrLvFKoZ__4wZOcsYqA2PnUi69RUfzGbQAwNNR-edd8ZDkoorwhcjD-Ewik59R-kmgL5dog0iODO1zMLqKTJReFqQ4c62s-4RHX2i0sNH6vXzZoGM_xsssSSI8tkwsNb6Xls2XZiK3d-xGmKjVzIiahRtFEG7RHQOU3zRQ9Y74wiDJYI5yzcwTJYdd2vLD8vasQubH5gA8crZi2-Bn02-17Kh9qvfNopGl9_Nh6ylpyzB3PCDAvgo8VmJh0zsSJy2HsM3vzrvpn3at9NUChHh9eiKUNjvAtiow3iUnJu0JVpaWI-W3fx-jtZ6O4_lzLPIH7okUzhN3Gb1b6fAnEK_fM1f87npMKXhWmcKevLr3weLqtPNkQ%3D%3D)

During my time as a Navy SEAL, I was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific – I've been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces.

But, running to be Montana's next U.S. Senator will be the toughest mission yet.

**Just look at where we are as a nation.** Since Joe Biden took office our once strong economy is no longer what it once was as we experience skyrocketing inflation, our borders are more porous than ever before, and the woke culture of the Left is tearing apart the very fabric of our society.

_**I cannot - and will not - remain quiet when I know I can be of service to you and your family in the U.S. Senate.**_

[**I've been training for this moment my entire life, Fellow Conservative.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=0cc97c60486b4cafb1332687188b1ca3&_e=ANe8ff3VXcCAPBDm83rJom9ivqkyvPylDuqBrLvFKoZ__4wZOcsYqA2PnUi69RUfzGbQAwNNR-edd8ZDkoorwhcjD-Ewik59R-kmgL5dog0iODO1zMLqKTJReFqQ4c62s-4RHX2i0sNH6vXzZoGM_xsssSSI8tkwsNb6Xls2XZiK3d-xGmKjVzIiahRtFEG7RHQOU3zRQ9Y74wiDJYI5yzcwTJYdd2vLD8vasQubH5gA8crZi2-Bn02-17Kh9qvf0ZAzC8igZBTveREkY1tG5s81lQ__If-1YdbA_tAQKAbbE4geI4P0C_ii7D0sbImHzUvOuze7MQTQPnOlrFlagmsscw_KLUVmCaDk1v9z2Cb9XTiLzy0Vbky5N8Z6bIv-Bjcmp_2fVdS-EmakNQ9hzw%3D%3D)

To accomplish this mission, it's going to take all of America working together as a TEAM. Our adversary is well-armed and has well insulated himself against attacks over his three-term career in D.C. That's why I'm going to be counting on having the best possible team around me to successfully navigate the terrain. I'm aware that this isn't going to be an easy race to win; you don't see people lining up to take on incumbents very often because truthfully, it isn't the easy thing to do. But as they say in the SEALS, _"nobody remembers a loser or a quitter."_

_**I can tell you this right now:[I'm going to be remembered as the guy who took down Jon Tester.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=0cc97c60486b4cafb1332687188b1ca3&_e=ANe8ff3VXcCAPBDm83rJom9ivqkyvPylDuqBrLvFKoZ__4wZOcsYqA2PnUi69RUfzGbQAwNNR-edd8ZDkoorwhcjD-Ewik59R-kmgL5dog0iODO1zMLqKTJReFqQ4c62s-4RHX2i0sNH6vXzZoGM_xsssSSI8tkwsNb6Xls2XZiK3d-xGmKjVzIiahRtFEG7RHQOU3zRQ9Y74wiDJYI5yzcwTJYdd2vLD8vasQubH5gA8crZi2-Bn02-17Kh9qvf8ZJG20q17CRQoYKQ0BPs0P8H8GpM-sZIA9xrA_RiT2KQ3ZJHLJPmKBBE4sFJkhVWABs0DVtUipxyugvbDlVan2B7TayIvJWzl1jbXUkfldL6LHeUdxslKUEsU0k6k1GGgL4-HskDP0HauB5d17B2nA%3D%3D) **_

[**Please, if you can, do me a favor and chip in $5, $10, $15 or even $25 right now.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=0cc97c60486b4cafb1332687188b1ca3&_e=ANe8ff3VXcCAPBDm83rJom9ivqkyvPylDuqBrLvFKoZ__4wZOcsYqA2PnUi69RUfzGbQAwNNR-edd8ZDkoorwhcjD-Ewik59R-kmgL5dog0iODO1zMLqKTJReFqQ4c62s-4RHX2i0sNH6vXzZoGM_xsssSSI8tkwsNb6Xls2XZiK3d-xGmKjVzIiahRtFEG7RHQOU3zRQ9Y74wiDJYI5yzcwTJYdd2vLD8vasQubH5gA8crZi2-Bn02-17Kh9qvfr0RcpnmJMBYCpC23IOqUJeOq6Mv8bbBGEN2uC90z8F0cX1o0UgGZslL3fwwZCPNQeod3MB-i0CIYQch06-vJp2lmXz5XcNoB-fKFU9ZFWwUM4bZl_T6E1RT8Zpiy1bJPQc2cdc-_0BTIfqBItUXZbA%3D%3D)

We need real, competent leadership to save our country and protect the American Dream for future generations.

Montana can do better.

Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com)

**Tell It Like It Is PAC Releases New Web Video: “The Recording”**
_Ad Responds To Bombshell Audio Of Trump’s Classified Documents_
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Today, Tell It Like It Is PAC released a web video in response to audio uncovered by CNN of former president Donald Trump discussing “highly confidential” and “secret” documents to guests at his Bedminster golf club. Entitled “The Recording,” the :60 second spot will air across digital platforms. The web video features public clips of Governor Chris Christie taking Trump to task for his negligence in handling classified information. In a CNN Town Hall, Christie blasted the decision to take classified documents on “summer vacation,” calling his actions “vanity run amok.” On the same day the ad was released, a poll from Saint Anselm College showed Governor Christie at third place in the Granite State, the third consecutive public survey to do so.

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d811110c4dcc4954b2170a63e6b1e582&_e=aIzRKQyEO0pwow4js_tdh2Pue5iOmkmFqKueybciKmf9emcg4CiVIQ-GJbwPJdFwMPuDuhGe3x9tvuH2__tm9iEfVuxMXpFdCvUVUVTfIqQAx_aBm8L_8wk2BLUjjxZB2XDUVNbr0G1XkHNsadPiruDu0TL3mjDCOhbnKXL5LqV-q4DkmQn7L80M0kBsQWhN7cBJ6UcSUBYt__9lotoD4-sec_wvyrKBXYY6gpt07zbCbSjpW1HXgpW-85gg_yme-NAmXsqT13nyUCXsPdqXW8qEzRCmzh8A8LGz_lyZg2SHPGb9hP6-SIh2HT0W8P9TH38xIQldi1R06ARn80BMY5sdAxhHWWU13fFn7BlEC3lh9GkSnIUbGlXRA9JPGfEbFZuY4KPRJtTWGZKSERCXZg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d811110c4dcc4954b2170a63e6b1e582&_e=aIzRKQyEO0pwow4js_tdh2Pue5iOmkmFqKueybciKmf9emcg4CiVIQ-GJbwPJdFwMPuDuhGe3x9tvuH2__tm9iEfVuxMXpFdCvUVUVTfIqQAx_aBm8L_8wk2BLUjjxZB2XDUVNbr0G1XkHNsadPiruDu0TL3mjDCOhbnKXL5LqV-q4DkmQn7L80M0kBsQWhN7cBJ6UcSUBYt__9lotoD4-sec_wvyrKBXYY6gpt07zbCbSjpW1HXgpW-85gg_ymeoKdIyPvSFIXosHmT2_wSmpCxIZZCURdbwrvSoXvOn0gLxoJtqgsSn2SzvFzGZeWWmIK3JxTZJvvjpCdTuLNKGqzKHlef5QazSkt5YP47g59jZIWDns3P8TEdqMalIBliHYe90XO2wrk6w4IFKMkl4Q%3D%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d811110c4dcc4954b2170a63e6b1e582&_e=aIzRKQyEO0pwow4js_tdh2Pue5iOmkmFqKueybciKmf9emcg4CiVIQ-GJbwPJdFwMPuDuhGe3x9tvuH2__tm9iEfVuxMXpFdCvUVUVTfIqQAx_aBm8L_8wk2BLUjjxZB2XDUVNbr0G1XkHNsadPiruDu0TL3mjDCOhbnKXL5LqV-q4DkmQn7L80M0kBsQWhN7cBJ6UcSUBYt__9lotoD4-sec_wvyrKBXYY6gpt07zbCbSjpW1HXgpW-85gg_yme1Bt46cksCplppEr5qiB3n6HDrRSAlHZ2kUpKmQboiXaZDHOt45iH0Wy6ELRKBoa-LozOQupRZT5_iAXUq1BJD8IO7RHNOAc5MYo8ykgKQ3JNZqXTJ2HvDi04dXLBlf0rXfH1TkB7cyqJSyvyK2kYlQ%3D%3D) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**Great news, team:** In a major win for our democracy, the Supreme Court has rejected the fringe right-wing independent state legislature theory in _Moore v. Harper_!

The Republican petitioners in _Moore v. Harper_ attempted to undermine our system of checks and balances by advancing the so-called “independent state legislature” theory – a truly fringe legal theory based on a willful misinterpretation of our Constitution. Quite frankly, the arguments advanced in this case were so extreme that the Supreme Court should never even have considered it.

Still, as Republican lawmakers in states across the country seek to cement their grip on unearned power, the threat posed by anti-democratic forces remains at large. [**_The NDRC remains committed to combating dangerous strategies like this, and we’ll continue fighting to strengthen our democracy. If you’re with us, will you donate today to support our work?_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65517810/413683346/-125216357?amount=30&refcode=EM_RTI_20230627_FR_6RR2_redlight922_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFkY2MzMjRhLTI3MTUtZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EFdQ-KzajcIl6N2jJ8_Oicf5SMVQL5Eb5se1MhDHNqU=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

Friend, Across the country, lawmakers have introduced and passed a record-breaking number of anti-LGBTQ+ bills. Many target transgender young people and attempt to block access to medically necessary, life-saving care. This is a traumatic time. According to the Trevor Project, 94% of LGBTQ youth reported that recent politics negatively impacted their mental health. 42% of LGBTQ youth (and more than half of transgender and nonbinary youth) seriously considered attempting suicide.1 Today is National PTSD Awareness Day, and it’s more urgent than ever to show up in solidarity for LGBTQ+ people. As a member of the Congressional Equality Caucus, I joined my colleagues last week in reintroducing the _Equality Act_ , to send a clear message that LGBTQ+ people deserve the same human dignity and legal protections from discrimination as every other American. | Peter,

I am elated to hear the news that the Supreme Court has ruled in favor of voters across the country in their decision in Moore v. Harper – a case that was set to upend state and national elections.

Moore v. Harper follows a years-long effort by North Carolina Republicans to grant state legislatures the power to regulate federal elections and dilute the power of the vote.

In a political environment rife with extreme Republican legislation to dismantle voting rights, it is no small feat that the Supreme Court ruled in favor of voters in North Carolina and across the country. This decision represents an enormous victory for our democracy.

**As we celebrate this victory, we cannot let our guard down. With the 2024 election coming into view, Republicans will continue their attempts at voter suppression at every chance they get.

_We can’t allow them to feel emboldened to do so._**

I ran for Congress to stand up for North Carolina families and protect our right to vote. I don’t intend to stop now. The fight to protect and expand access to the ballot box, advocate for fair districting, and combat voter suppression tactics continues. [**June 27, 1950:** The United States officially entered the Korean War to support the Republic of Korea (South Korea) and repel an invasion from the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (North Korea). | | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9c358465-381c-4128-9e16-73ac5ef7017e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Peter, After the polls closed in my 2022 campaign against Ken Calvert, we were feeling pretty excited about our chances. The first few batches of votes released by the registrar showed us with a promising lead, and while the race hadn’t been called, things were good enough to get an invitation to attend new member orientation in Washington. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb440c97a-555e-4bbb-8161-ae91e2843a32/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Day one of new member orientation last Fall. Credit: POLITICO. It was awe-inspiring being inside the Capitol as a prospective member and learning about the job I’d spent a year running for and hoped to have. I also enjoyed getting to know some (we had hoped) soon-to-be colleagues. Then, literally as I was standing on the House floor, I got the alert on my phone; a new batch of votes finally put Ken Calvert’s vote share out of reach. The Associated Press called the race, and I officially lost. So my partner Paolo and I did what a lot of couples might do: we went to the hotel bar. As we were sitting there, news broke on TV that Donald Trump had just announced his campaign for president. And I knew in that moment that our fight wasn’t over yet — that our democracy remains fragile, and it’s on each of us to do what’s in our power to better our communities and our country. Peter, running for Congress a second time was not a decision I came to lightly, but I'm back in it because I know exactly what is at stake. It’s not the time to give up, and I’ve been so humbled that so many across Riverside County who supported our campaign in 2022 haven’t given up either. We came closer than anyone expected in 2022 to flipping this seat, and I wouldn’t be in this if I wasn’t confident we could win. But I can’t do this alone: [The end of this month marks our first public FEC fundraising deadline of my campaign. I’m counting on you to be a part of this effort, Peter. Please split $20 between Blue Amp Action and our campaign, or whatever you can afford, to help us flip CA-41 and finish the job against Ken Calvert.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4007d25f-74a0-45e9-8457-63492ab24043/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) As always, thanks for your support. Will

Peter,
I want to share something I’m thinking about a *lot*.
Bob Casey’s Senate seat is gonna be a real toss-up, and the Democratic majority we fought so hard to keep could hinge on what happens in PA in 2024. All eyes are on us as we fight to re-elect Bob.
Don’t just take my word for it — CNN has rated Pennsylvania one of the top 10 competitive Senate seats in the country. That’s why helping Bob and his team reach their upcoming end-of-quarter fundraising goal is so critical _right now._
**[Peter, if we’re going to defend our control of the Senate, we need your help. Please, can you chip in anything today to help win another term for Bob Casey?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230627-2?refcode=em20230627-2&refcode2=180_552475_MEcB6O&akid=180%2E552475%2EMEcB6O)**

Republicans have made it clear that Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, reproductive freedoms, and protections for working families are all on the chopping block if they retake control of the Senate.
We can’t let that happen — there is simply too much on the line. But in order to defend our freedoms and keep the government working for working people, we need momentum on the side of Bob Casey aaaaaall the way to Election Day.
**[So if you can, please, make a donation to reach Bob Casey’s end-of-quarter goal and send him to another term with me in the Senate.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230627-2?refcode=em20230627-2&refcode2=180_552475_MEcB6O&akid=180%2E552475%2EMEcB6O)**

Thank you,
💛 John

Peter,

My name is Tim Sheehy - I'm a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot.

I'll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I'm answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will step-up and serve our GREAT nation. **My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career.**

[**chip in any amount
Send a Navy SEAL to the Senate**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=098ca747fa1440308bea119a98dcee7d&_e=iOkXi-WwwnfTd2lNMQfK_ksFTGqfjKP4MxU1E1MlylYHnej7lZCGcIf00jr82whUNxos5yg1tLhiQTi5yDlyOkfNo9xjhK6-WY22lTNgay2G7qAQdc3lDw7SLoBkbizG9yVASrgPiSPUaAYbm4nzKbfMdK0QhE0YsAO4IshXA0B3YaWxQj0E0KjsMQ2Us7dEmP8kAW7n1wgS0DSLooL6HjPHZ4GhgNOwLU4DJunb5X44CL8cg_6261eIiWPOKFZb_GEpSw8ZG1jJyO6ur-LhrHlNnSlAAZZwOzXtAL4XruFYaJRPYy_j4TUMzVOwRrBTxSUa_5OKM4qB8idEpWPmxvtKOFKkTMQ-uBxzCeoCM7V8e-TZzVrPDhNcfMJDQaB5Abmwt-zaUxe91vaS3wMIsA%3D%3D)
You don't know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I've fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm.

Career politicians like Democrat Jon Tester, **who has been in elected office for nearly 25 years** , are not getting the job done. **[That's why I'm challenging him for his seat in the United States Senate.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=098ca747fa1440308bea119a98dcee7d&_e=iOkXi-WwwnfTd2lNMQfK_ksFTGqfjKP4MxU1E1MlylYHnej7lZCGcIf00jr82whUNxos5yg1tLhiQTi5yDlyOkfNo9xjhK6-WY22lTNgay2G7qAQdc3lDw7SLoBkbizG9yVASrgPiSPUaAYbm4nzKbfMdK0QhE0YsAO4IshXA0B3YaWxQj0E0KjsMQ2Us7dEmP8kAW7n1wgS0DSLooL6HjPHZ4GhgNOwLU4DJunb5X44CL8cg_6261eIiWPOKFZbSfawEybwJitCyeEMtTg_5vVS1k75xH_zt63icPdjBySPyRmEcgpvvzEJHprU6sMhTO-SX4JAnb7NCITMwQ8di_UPbiwBBv8II6Khxxnw_iHEcpHffKVmaQZpmLf72hcxflDSp4vMnEHGlgwoIWubBg%3D%3D) **

**As a Navy SEAL, I fought and bled for this country – _and considering our crippling debt, open borders, and woke culture_ ** [**I'm prepared to sacrifice even more of myself for the betterment of all Americans.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=098ca747fa1440308bea119a98dcee7d&_e=iOkXi-WwwnfTd2lNMQfK_ksFTGqfjKP4MxU1E1MlylYHnej7lZCGcIf00jr82whUNxos5yg1tLhiQTi5yDlyOkfNo9xjhK6-WY22lTNgay2G7qAQdc3lDw7SLoBkbizG9yVASrgPiSPUaAYbm4nzKbfMdK0QhE0YsAO4IshXA0B3YaWxQj0E0KjsMQ2Us7dEmP8kAW7n1wgS0DSLooL6HjPHZ4GhgNOwLU4DJunb5X44CL8cg_6261eIiWPOKFZbN6xX-uRRKON1dSbVYBToCK4TJk8Gl7EdgjTuzwlh7pqiCa8E-07TWgY5UKeIcQ_gLClbfd4ikhPIP5e2jZK2hQtKamdlw2tIEtpwu2nCiBgWK_qTWiBN_GmEXjpPdfG-3Jp5NvVZfn831ow-GUXaXA%3D%3D)

We need strong leaders who will solve problems and put Montana - and America - FIRST.

When I joined the Navy, I made a commitment not only to myself, but to my country. Our country. Those of you reading this today who served in the Armed Forces will know that the commitment we made to America when we joined up isn't just for four, six, or even 20 years - it's lifelong.

[**My mission continues in a different way now, and I'm asking you to support me not only with your prayers, but with your financial backing, too.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=098ca747fa1440308bea119a98dcee7d&_e=iOkXi-WwwnfTd2lNMQfK_ksFTGqfjKP4MxU1E1MlylYHnej7lZCGcIf00jr82whUNxos5yg1tLhiQTi5yDlyOkfNo9xjhK6-WY22lTNgay2G7qAQdc3lDw7SLoBkbizG9yVASrgPiSPUaAYbm4nzKbfMdK0QhE0YsAO4IshXA0B3YaWxQj0E0KjsMQ2Us7dEmP8kAW7n1wgS0DSLooL6HjPHZ4GhgNOwLU4DJunb5X44CL8cg_6261eIiWPOKFZbYzLId3YzvlgPeyRhf_NTiPeyKuGBlU0rCe2XuDM0ZEWIwJLYFXBESbjudh9TOotgzcHqTq56LUyq-C-646HCu90N7mnOVU8P8e8ktabaYrqj3edd1R-q8EGEAxWJD54Y0x7rZg-tQDzt-soxy_z6Gw%3D%3D)

[**SEND IN THE SEAL
CHIP IN TODAY**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=098ca747fa1440308bea119a98dcee7d&_e=iOkXi-WwwnfTd2lNMQfK_ksFTGqfjKP4MxU1E1MlylYHnej7lZCGcIf00jr82whUNxos5yg1tLhiQTi5yDlyOkfNo9xjhK6-WY22lTNgay2G7qAQdc3lDw7SLoBkbizG9yVASrgPiSPUaAYbm4nzKbfMdK0QhE0YsAO4IshXA0B3YaWxQj0E0KjsMQ2Us7dEmP8kAW7n1wgS0DSLooL6HjPHZ4GhgNOwLU4DJunb5X44CL8cg_6261eIiWPOKFZba8Y0ae33RU-yFkx1uKw4b55kcMFHia4y63WDPt-qMukFB8uKUSUD-kClaqDHCbdrTMG2YAguMxtOxAD71r9oMmqKu5bgYulixii7NELYHGthSlWubx4UU-d4jpUYWS7pgzcI4yeTrt7PBRd8oHQ-4Q%3D%3D)
During my time as a Navy SEAL, I was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific – I've been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces.

There’s a lot that the Attorney General can do to improve the lives of Mississippians, but our current AG is more concerned with attacking reproductive freedom no matter your zip code, and building her own political profile.

As Mississippi’s Attorney General, I want to ensure protections for our workers by establishing a Fair Labor Division, especially since our state doesn’t have a Department of Labor for workers to turn to right now. I want to create resources for survivors of domestic violence to live full, healthy lives after experiencing trauma and instability. And I want to hold state officials accountable with legal action when they funnel money meant to support our low-income families to their wealthy celebrity friends.

These are problems that have been ignored by our current AG, and I’m running to change that.

[Will you support my campaign to be the people’s AG ahead of our midnight filing deadline at the end of the week with $10, $25, or whatever you can today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65527337/413694537/-456841951?refcode=EM_FR_230627PeoplesAG_GKM_9_90DO_TESTB_l2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzNDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMGE1ZmFlNGYtMzExNS1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_KIQ71syHuMYlm6M69o8ZVkMLzXnNPYLcBNGTqTyNrQ=)

Dear Friend,

Fourteen years ago, I founded an organization from my parent's home with the intent of using undercover investigative journalism to expose the corrupt.

You've seen my work. Most Americans have.

In February, after releasing a historic investigation on Pfizer, the Board of Directors of the organization I created from scratch, ousted me.

It was a blow, but things happen for a reason. Today, I'm unleashed to do my work through my new organization, OMG, without any obstruction and **no one to stop me.**

Since I was fired, I've chosen not to look back. I want to move forward with my work, with happiness and spirit. **And I move forward carrying with me the many lessons I learned.**

Those 14 years were formative.

When I started, my hands would tremble when I confronted a target of my investigations. It took time, but I overcame my fears of confrontation by grounding myself in principle.

I learned about trust, loyalty, and leadership.

Most importantly, I learned the hard way the true depth of Michael Jordan's quote on leadership: "Winning has a price. **And leadership has a price**."

I've been sued for exposing the truth more times than I can count. And, get this, **yesterday, I was sued in federal court by the very organization I founded.**

In my opinion, their intent is to shut me down now that they no longer have any control over me.

And this lawsuit is going to cost me a fortune! That's why I'm writing you today to **[ask for your support to my legal defense fund.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e16796810f9748efa0f0ae44cedd46bc&_e=2TaZg19vNNyQjqX8svgYuw4j2hfbTaapcnCQ7vbfLWLjp41tuWq_njrxQQ2JnIBNKpsAYzVj8z--2wgE27SnqSDyyLmJse23LRRe0np9IpoJ6EDm66sPK65bA7ghu2LyoqwZiXgc30wM0u10K6tcemm64yLyPFLOmiF4YqF_fr9FXr4f3BcYRvbiPLNlz6KaYPOg4yIeYfryaGcdUCbAeAhbr5A48j_9-tj10kvpYwEr6AVfD1TixfqCdtmklWlYdJdaL2zTL-cxjJ0JJiwKW5M77Ergdz--fDM9CdQ3cfUsUyovZ2TluVQu-JZUWCz9G27IeBeaCz2uBSXdQXWrRxMK2rX_WrW__BFIib0IZM1gV9JmPlIzFsKcBbtMajrG)**

My friends with the non-profit, Liberty Guard, have set up **[the fund to pay attorney costs](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e16796810f9748efa0f0ae44cedd46bc&_e=2TaZg19vNNyQjqX8svgYuw4j2hfbTaapcnCQ7vbfLWLjp41tuWq_njrxQQ2JnIBNKpsAYzVj8z--2wgE27SnqSDyyLmJse23LRRe0np9IpoJ6EDm66sPK65bA7ghu2LyoqwZiXgc30wM0u10K6tcemm64yLyPFLOmiF4YqF_fr9FXr4f3BcYRvbiPLNlz6KaYPOg4yIeYfryaGcdUCbAeBK-VMTMntImD3_Fqwe6vBLQeNNgo9TkfiHXWuwEs-eYIQ7mn21Esyu5eNnfh_9A--3Y4KcCAqv1GmP6LZb7fQ3SQyV8hOTx0lK19T_3-2WPgLPgbTANc-nL_AThso6D0Fsf7Cu21KuKp0gjfNr_-c_Qs0nPUvgjMB4y60Z0IvYP)** that will quickly pile up.

As I mentioned, this isn't my first rodeo so I know that **the cost will exceed $500,000**.

Good attorneys aren't cheap, and my pockets are not deep.

No one gets wealthy doing the work that I do. Trust me.

That's where you come in. **[Will you chip in and help me defend myself](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e16796810f9748efa0f0ae44cedd46bc&_e=2TaZg19vNNyQjqX8svgYuw4j2hfbTaapcnCQ7vbfLWLjp41tuWq_njrxQQ2JnIBNKpsAYzVj8z--2wgE27SnqSDyyLmJse23LRRe0np9IpoJ6EDm66sPK65bA7ghu2LyoqwZiXgc30wM0u10K6tcemm64yLyPFLOmiF4YqF_fr9FXr4f3BcYRvbiPLNlz6KaYPOg4yIeYfryaGcdUCbAeGHMes5od09zRtcoR2sf9WKCh_V0K7VdiuMrgVwWV15w55_7tdEjv9t3Mn2XBI1FSNa0pDSgTbIJ1Ae34X3UTxBZZGTwijx3nV2hdixyb5bDVDBFBzs40Zg7NPRWELri4cxs68hh26lh9-sflJeRpXyCWGQuw1ToKHrMrMUdH1Zw)?**

When you do, I'll be following up as the case progresses but I'll also keep you informed of the great work I'm doing at OMG . . . and it's exciting!

A fresh start, being forced to start over, I'll admit is thrilling. And I'm starting armed with all of the lessons I've learned to avoid the pitfalls I've experienced.

Me and my teams are more efficient, we're more productive, and our work hits like a sledgehammer.

But my work will be silenced if my former employer gets their way. Or the distractions of a court battle and its costs may become overwhelming.

**[I'm asking you to STAND UP FOR ME, so I can keep working](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e16796810f9748efa0f0ae44cedd46bc&_e=2TaZg19vNNyQjqX8svgYuw4j2hfbTaapcnCQ7vbfLWLjp41tuWq_njrxQQ2JnIBNKpsAYzVj8z--2wgE27SnqSDyyLmJse23LRRe0np9IpoJ6EDm66sPK65bA7ghu2LyoqwZiXgc30wM0u10K6tcemm64yLyPFLOmiF4YqF_fr9FXr4f3BcYRvbiPLNlz6KaYPOg4yIeYfryaGcdUCbAeGCdmfnW11H8HHAGchcTEhLMz0vOXC7TZablOB1ygrD6YLNlPV32r3p38-Nttg8c91Ov8sKD2NTaQjqwGcTRxvyu0QQPNycg0t8VPCmO5iFSIfBVuAVt2QAf1gs8-bTkOFF_uutCeY6tGivZruXIio0AxRTvAphkWn13WgBJ_8qn)**. And I'll commit to you that **I will NOT let you down**.

So please, **[make a donation to my legal defense fund through Liberty Guard](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e16796810f9748efa0f0ae44cedd46bc&_e=2TaZg19vNNyQjqX8svgYuw4j2hfbTaapcnCQ7vbfLWLjp41tuWq_njrxQQ2JnIBNKpsAYzVj8z--2wgE27SnqSDyyLmJse23LRRe0np9IpoJ6EDm66sPK65bA7ghu2LyoqwZiXgc30wM0u10K6tcemm64yLyPFLOmiF4YqF_fr9FXr4f3BcYRvbiPLNlz6KaYPOg4yIeYfryaGcdUCbAeNYqc3PGtItJilB0ZYInpMsTLc4cGHdCSYz5a5dSHs5u1U1oRC9TvWv5sr-qqSyddesb16JFsytcKF2eih-5_6EGvPeHrHIBEEU8O7kAu46gphbbMxXsR8DTtebANBOBNaSsD2iIwUJpyE2HaDPmDcihf7pnC1mlT1Iy9rn2At92)**. We have a long way to do to hit our goal, so please, donate as much as you can.

Thank you for your direct or indirect support over the years. Your views, donations or simply talking about my work to friends and family has kept me going for 14 years . . . **and we cannot stop now!**

Respectfully,

James O'Keefe

P.S. I have 20 days to file my response to the lawsuit. I have to raise enough money to pay for a retainer and cover the legal work to defend against this lawsuit. This is unfortunately urgent so please, **[donate today](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e16796810f9748efa0f0ae44cedd46bc&_e=2TaZg19vNNyQjqX8svgYuw4j2hfbTaapcnCQ7vbfLWLjp41tuWq_njrxQQ2JnIBNKpsAYzVj8z--2wgE27SnqSDyyLmJse23LRRe0np9IpoJ6EDm66sPK65bA7ghu2LyoqwZiXgc30wM0u10K6tcemm64yLyPFLOmiF4YqF_fr9FXr4f3BcYRvbiPLNlz6KaYPOg4yIeYfryaGcdUCbAeGqmb29L_YMil-wxwJfjWFE0qrL4FrhrHvCPgvEmIZA3btPGVa88y82i2Be1aYtYdszLhvv9crS3QKatPzdMmYi2vkKYxZGe55-qFXnZBxszZhiurMPUr4iazdASC0L_iJSI-TqDiO8rJY5A80u1l541C1j6GYgpVH4RpuB0a54O)**.

Peter, can I share something with you?

When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service, but I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65530946/413707631/560479937?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk62-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzE3YzIwOS0zZjE1LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LDzOw4J6qbHaPhHA2rUApO2YOqV81tbcE-jvh5mvMz8=)
Seeing others in the LGBTQ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves and being public about who they are and who they love – I came to realize that I could do both. **I could run for office and be honest about who I am. And that’s exactly what I did.**

When I became the first openly gay Senator in our nation's history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. And from lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that.
That's why I ran for office in the first place – not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too. Now, I'm asking you to keep going:
**[Will you help me continue to make a difference by splitting a donation between my reelection campaign and Patty Murray today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65530947/413707632/560479937?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk62-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzE3YzIwOS0zZjE1LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LDzOw4J6qbHaPhHA2rUApO2YOqV81tbcE-jvh5mvMz8=)**
Over the years, we have made incredible progress in the fight for equality. But Peter, we cannot mistake that progress for a total victory.

Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ youth.

And when the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , Justice Clarence Thomas called for _Obergefell v. Hodges_ – the case that established nationwide marriage equality – to be “reconsidered.”
**[For all of the progress we have made, there is still a LOT more to be done. I’ll keep up the fight as long as I can, and I’m hoping you’ll support our important work by splitting a donation between my reelection campaign and Patty Murray today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65530948/413707633/560479937?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk62-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzE3YzIwOS0zZjE1LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LDzOw4J6qbHaPhHA2rUApO2YOqV81tbcE-jvh5mvMz8=)**

That was the day I announced I was planning to challenge Senator Sinema. I didn't know what to expect when I was preparing to announce. I wasn't sure what the reaction would be. But the outpouring of support was humbling to say the least.

**January 6, 2021**
Taking a step backward, I'll never forget that day. I doubt you will either. I was ready to fight that day -- for our democracy. I'll never forget teaching my colleagues how to put on gas masks. # [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=290%2E791427%2ELgbAed)
Friends,
We are engaged in many struggles right now for the future of our country and our planet. We are trying to save the planet from the ravages of climate change. We're trying to create an economy that works for all and not just the billionaire class. We're trying to defend our democracy against those who are moving us toward authoritarianism. And that's just to name a few.
But it is not all doom and gloom. One thing that makes me optimistic about the future is that there are more really strong young progressives — often people of color — in the House now than ever before.
But we cannot stop here.
We need to continue electing candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. And in order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country.

****
In 1991, I co-founded the Congressional Progressive Caucus alongside 5 of my colleagues because I believed that working people needed more of a voice in Congress. And today, I’m proud to see that it has grown to more than 100 members, including Ilhan Omar, and is now one of the largest caucuses in Congress.
In the midst of all the struggles facing our nation and our planet, we cannot simply remain on the defensive. We need to continue building our movement to transform this country. And that means electing progressive leaders who will fight to protect social security, raise the minimum wage, get big money out of politics, and guarantee health care as a human right.
But it is not going to be easy.
Big Pharma, Big Oil, and other corporate interests have in past election cycles spent many millions of dollars attacking progressive candidates.
The good news is that despite the avalanche of right-wing spending, we have still been able to elect many strong candidates like Ilhan.
The bad news is that some excellent progressive candidates have been defeated by this right-wing money.
It should not be a radical proposition to say that the very wealthiest people in this country should not be able to control our political system and who represents us in government.
This great nation and its government belongs to ALL of our people, not just right-wing billionaires and their Super PACs.
**[So please, split a contribution between Ilhan and the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC and help us take on the outrageous sums of money flowing into our political system.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-june23-cpc.AiljbI&refcode=em230627-1-t2-nor&t=9&akid=290%2E791427%2ELgbAed)**
All across the country, people are coming together and saying “enough is enough.” They are tired of tinkering around the edges of the problem — on climate change, on racial justice, on economic justice.
We’ve already shown what’s possible when working people stand together — and if we continue to do so, together we will elect a Congress that works for all of us, not just the 1%.
Thank you again for supporting Ilhan and the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC if you can afford to do so.
In solidarity,
Sen. Bernie Sanders

| | Peter,

After the polls closed in my 2022 campaign against Ken Calvert, we were feeling pretty excited about our chances. The first few batches of votes released by the registrar showed us with a promising lead, and while the race hadn’t been called, things were good enough to get an invitation to attend new member orientation in Washington. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zb5Af2XktmfUYzaRkqR3S841ZU59TKgaA-ObfET0oOHY3lXyvWCVVQdxpUZGy-HwGKpT-y9iWkn8zLrxXshjcBqVSWFLZ0bi47kS041qcmgWGIzrZFiT6iePWpu4YOgvbmWbKx5kKjoql4y3t8IdOuZFfFK6vidSNE4roVnUvgdPZhrYC2WSkBU72NdPSmEgT5dYOd6VUNlbpB-flVwyXFDNt7d0RwZtPPU2VFjPrHv6j1HJE6zUAVmPjwfoFizuPj49soMvjqGuKo4PVj0ghX2z9FYbI8b6ok_ed_wpKGKA/3xe/KTpKAHCkRdKlZaIfJhxk4g/h0/DnfdTBAv6R9BJXa1e7aSJC22KfB5q8ZwJHV3NVljClk) _Day one of new member orientation last Fall. Credit: POLITICO._
It was awe-inspiring being inside the Capitol as a prospective member and learning about the job I’d spent a year running for and hoped to have. I also enjoyed getting to know some (we had hoped) soon-to-be colleagues.

**Then, literally as I was standing on the House floor, I got the alert on my phone; a new batch of votes finally put Ken Calvert’s vote share out of reach. The Associated Press called the race, and I officially lost.**

So my partner Paolo and I did what a lot of couples might do: we went to the hotel bar.

As we were sitting there, news broke on TV that Donald Trump had just announced his campaign for president.

And I knew in that moment that our fight wasn’t over yet — that our democracy remains fragile, and it’s on each of us to do what’s in our power to better our communities and our country.

Running for Congress a second time was not a decision I came to lightly, but I'm back in it because I know exactly what is at stake. It’s not the time to give up, and I’ve been so humbled that so many across Riverside County who supported our campaign in 2022 haven’t given up either.

**We came closer than anyone expected in 2022 to flipping this seat, and I wouldn’t be in this if I wasn’t confident we could win. But I can’t do this alone:**

clean_body: | | | Peter, After the polls closed in my 2022 campaign against Ken Calvert, we were feeling pretty excited about our chances. The first few batches of votes released by the registrar showed us with a promising lead, and while the race hadn’t been called, things were good enough to get an invitation to attend new member orientation in Washington. Day one of new member orientation last Fall. Credit: POLITICO. It was awe-inspiring being inside the Capitol as a prospective member and learning about the job I’d spent a year running for and hoped to have. I also enjoyed getting to know some (we had hoped) soon-to-be colleagues. Then, literally as I was standing on the House floor, I got the alert on my phone; a new batch of votes finally put Ken Calvert’s vote share out of reach. The Associated Press called the race, and I officially lost. So my partner Paolo and I did what a lot of couples might do: we went to the hotel bar. As we were sitting there, news broke on TV that Donald Trump had just announced his campaign for president. And I knew in that moment that our fight wasn’t over yet — that our democracy remains fragile, and it’s on each of us to do what’s in our power to better our communities and our country. Running for Congress a second time was not a decision I came to lightly, but I'm back in it because I know exactly what is at stake. It’s not the time to give up, and I’ve been so humbled that so many across Riverside County who supported our campaign in 2022 haven’t given up either. We came closer than anyone expected in 2022 to flipping this seat, and I wouldn’t be in this if I wasn’t confident we could win. But I can’t do this alone: | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Democrats Serve and Will Rollins will process immediately. | | | | | | As always, thanks for your support.
